import { characterStatRows } from './character-stats-panel.js';
import { createBitmapText } from './bitmap-font.js';
import { applyEnhancedWeaponGlow } from './weapon-glow.js';
import { drawSynergyIcon } from './synergy-icon.js';
import { getArisWeapon } from './aris-weapon.js';
import { getUmbrella } from './weapon-progression.js';
import { levelUpgradeSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { rollLevelUpgrades, applyLevelUpgrade } from './level-upgrades.js';

const statRows = characterStatRows;

/** Pause on pending levels, present four upgrades, and resume after all choices are spent. */
export function createLevelUpMenu({ canvas, getPlayer, isPauseMenuOpen, releaseControls, onOpen, onChoose }) {
  const overlay = document.querySelector('#level-up-menu');
  const choicesElement = document.querySelector('#level-up-choices');
  const continueButton = document.querySelector('#level-up-continue');
  let player = null, choices = [], selected = 0, previousInert = [];
  const textRenderers = new WeakMap();
  const observers = new Map();

  /** Create accessible, wrapped sprite-font copy with consistent baselines. */
  function text(element, value, scale = 1.2) {
    let renderer = textRenderers.get(element);
    if (!renderer) {
      const graphic = document.createElement('canvas');
      element.replaceChildren(graphic);
      renderer = createBitmapText(graphic, { variant: 'font2', scale, outlineOverlap: 1,
        maxWidth: Math.max(100, element.clientWidth || 400), wrap: element.tagName === 'P' });
      textRenderers.set(element, renderer);

    }
    if (!observers.has(element)) {
      const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => renderer.setMaxWidth(Math.max(100, element.clientWidth)));
      observer.observe(element); observers.set(element, observer);
    }
    renderer.setText(value);
  }

  /** Highlight/focus a choice, supporting mouse and keyboard equally. */
  function select(index, focus = true) {
    if (!choices.length) { continueButton.focus({ preventScroll: true }); return; }
    selected = (index + choices.length) % choices.length;
    [...choicesElement.children].forEach((button, i) => {
      button.classList.toggle('selected', i === selected);
      button.tabIndex = i === selected ? 0 : -1;
    });
    if (focus) choicesElement.children[selected]?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  /** Apply once, then show the next queued level or return control to gameplay. */
  function choose(index) {
    if (!player || !choices[index] || !applyLevelUpgrade(player, choices[index].id)) return;
    onChoose(player);
    if (player.pendingUpgrades > 0) render();
    else close();
  }

  /** Render character stats and a fresh choice set for one earned level. */
  function render() {
    for (const observer of observers.values()) observer.disconnect();
    observers.clear();
    text(document.querySelector('#level-up-title'), 'LEVEL UP!', 2);
    text(document.querySelector('#level-up-help'), 'Choose an upgrade to continue. Up / Down to select, Enter to confirm.', .9);
    text(document.querySelector('#level-up-name'), player.label, 1.3);
    const earnedLevel = player.level - player.pendingUpgrades + 1;
    text(document.querySelector('#level-up-progress'), `Level ${earnedLevel} - Choose an upgrade`, 1.1);
    const portrait = document.querySelector('#level-up-portrait');
    const label = player.label.toLowerCase();
    const source = label.includes('plana') ? '../sprites/Plana_Portrait.png'
      : label.includes('arona') ? '../sprites/Arona_Portrait.png' : '';
    portrait.hidden = !source;
    if (source) portrait.src = source;
    const stats = document.querySelector('#level-up-stats');
    stats.replaceChildren();
    for (const [name, icon, value] of statRows) {
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'level-up-stat';
      const image = document.createElement('img'); image.src = `../sprites/icons/${icon}`; image.alt = '';
      const nameElement = document.createElement('span'), valueElement = document.createElement('span');
      row.append(image, nameElement, valueElement); stats.append(row);
      text(nameElement, name, 1); text(valueElement, value(player), 1);
    }
    choices = rollLevelUpgrades(player);
    choicesElement.replaceChildren();
    continueButton.hidden = choices.length > 0;
    if (!choices.length) text(document.querySelector('#level-up-help'), 'No upgrades available. Continue to resume.', .9);
    text(continueButton, 'Continue', 1.2);
    const weapon = getUmbrella(player) || getArisWeapon(player);
    const displayed = choices.length ? choices : weapon ? [{ name: `${weapon.name || "Weapon"} - MAX`, weapon,
      category: weapon.awakened ? 'Awakened' : 'LV 7',
      description: weapon.awakened ? 'This weapon is fully awakened.' : 'Maximum level reached. Collect a Secret Tech Note to awaken it.' }] : [];
    displayed.forEach((upgrade, index) => {
      const button = document.createElement('button');
      button.type = 'button'; button.className = 'level-up-choice';
      button.setAttribute('aria-label', `${upgrade.name}. ${upgrade.description}`);
      const header = document.createElement('div'); header.className = 'level-up-choice-header';
      const title = document.createElement('span'), category = document.createElement('span');
      header.append(title, category);
      const body = document.createElement('div'); body.className = 'level-up-choice-body';
      const icon = document.createElement('canvas'); icon.width = icon.height = 128;
      icon.className = 'level-up-weapon-icon';
      applyEnhancedWeaponGlow(icon,upgrade.weapon);
      icon.setAttribute('aria-label', upgrade.weapon.name || upgrade.name);
      if (upgrade.weapon.awakened || upgrade.id?.endsWith('-awaken')) icon.classList.add('awakened-icon');
      const image = new Image();
      image.onload = () => {
        if(drawSynergyIcon(icon,upgrade.weapon))return;
        const crop = upgrade.weapon.iconCrop || { x: 0, y: 0, width: image.naturalWidth, height: image.naturalHeight };
        const context = icon.getContext('2d');
        const angle = (upgrade.weapon.iconRotation || 0) * Math.PI / 180;
        context.translate(64, 64); context.rotate(angle);
        const width = Math.abs(crop.width * Math.cos(angle)) + Math.abs(crop.height * Math.sin(angle));
        const height = Math.abs(crop.width * Math.sin(angle)) + Math.abs(crop.height * Math.cos(angle));
        const scale = 120 / Math.max(width, height);
        context.drawImage(image, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
          -crop.width*scale/2, -crop.height*scale/2, crop.width*scale, crop.height*scale);
      };
      image.src = upgrade.weapon.icon;
      const description = document.createElement('p');
      body.append(icon, description); button.append(header, body); choicesElement.append(button);
      text(title, upgrade.name, 1.3); text(category, upgrade.category, 1); text(description, upgrade.description, 1.2);
      button.disabled = !choices.length;
      button.addEventListener('click', () => choose(index));
      button.addEventListener('pointerenter', () => select(index, false));
    });
    for (let i = displayed.length; i < levelUpgradeSettings.choices; i++) {
      const empty = document.createElement('div'); empty.className = 'level-up-empty-slot';
      empty.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); choicesElement.append(empty);
    }
    select(0);
  }

  /** Restore developer controls only after the final queued level has been resolved. */
  function close() {
    player = null; overlay.hidden = true;
    for (const observer of observers.values()) observer.disconnect();
    observers.clear();
    for (const [element, inert] of previousInert) element.inert = inert;
    previousInert = [];
    releaseControls(); canvas.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  continueButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (!player || choices.length) return;
    player.pendingUpgrades = 0;
    onChoose(player); close();
  });
  overlay.addEventListener('contextmenu', event => event.preventDefault());

const animationCache=new WeakMap();

/** Average every aligned pose once, then share one stable oval across the animation set. */
export function animationSpriteHurtbox(character,getFrameRectangle,padding=8) {
  const identity=character.animationFrames||character.image;
  let sizes=animationCache.get(identity);if(!sizes){sizes=new Map();animationCache.set(identity,sizes);}
  const size=character.spriteSize||89.6,key=`${size}:${character.referenceSize||215}`;
  if(sizes.has(key))return sizes.get(key);
  const scale=(size-padding*2)/(character.referenceSize||215),poses=[];
  if(character.animationFrames) {
    const clips=[character.animationFrames,...Object.values(character.actionAnimations||{})];
    for(const frames of clips)for(const frame of frames) {
      const image=frame.image;
      poses.push({image,crop:{x:0,y:0,width:image.naturalWidth,height:image.naturalHeight,footY:image.naturalHeight}});
    }
  } else {
    for(const direction of Object.keys(character.rows||{}))for(let frame=0;frame<character.layout.columnEdges.length-1;frame++) {
      poses.push({image:character.image,crop:getFrameRectangle({...character,attack:null,moving:true,direction,facing:direction},frame)});
    }
    for(const name of Object.keys(character.attacks||{}))for(const facing of Object.keys(character.attacks[name].rows))
      for(let frame=0;frame<character.layout.columnEdges.length-1;frame++)
        poses.push({image:character.image,crop:getFrameRectangle({...character,attack:{name,facing}},frame)});
  }

export function drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,diameter=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter,duration=luminousNovaSettings.duration) {
  const s=luminousNovaSettings,radius=diameter/2;
  // Preserve gradient opacity and pale hot highlights while tinting the full plasma effect.
  const tint=value=>{
    if(bullet.color==='orange') {
      const orange=(r,g,b)=>[Number(r),Math.round(80+Number(g)*.60),Math.round(Number(g)*.20)];
      if(value.startsWith('#'))return '#'+orange(parseInt(value.slice(1,3),16),parseInt(value.slice(3,5),16),parseInt(value.slice(5,7),16)).map(n=>n.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
      return value.replace(/(rgba?\()(\d+),(\d+),(\d+)/,(_,prefix,r,g,b)=>prefix+orange(r,g,b).join(','));
    }
    return bullet.color!=='blue'?value:value.startsWith('#')
      ? '#'+value.slice(3,5)+value.slice(5,7)+value.slice(1,3)
      : value.replace(/(rgba?\()(\d+),(\d+),(\d+)/, '$1$3,$4,$2');
  };
  // Skip the whole effect once both its head and longest wake have left the canvas.
  const reach=radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio+s.bloomRadiusScale);
  const screenX=bullet.x-camera.x,screenY=bullet.y-camera.y;
  if(context.canvas&&(screenX+reach<0||screenY+reach<0||screenX-reach>context.canvas.width||screenY-reach>context.canvas.height))return;

export function drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,diameter=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter,duration=luminousNovaSettings.duration) {
  const s=luminousNovaSettings,radius=diameter/2;
  // Preserve gradient opacity and pale hot highlights while tinting the full plasma effect.
  const tint=value=>{
    if(bullet.color==='orange') {
      const orange=(r,g,b)=>[Number(r),Math.round(80+Number(g)*.60),Math.round(Number(g)*.20)];
      if(value.startsWith('#'))return '#'+orange(parseInt(value.slice(1,3),16),parseInt(value.slice(3,5),16),parseInt(value.slice(5,7),16)).map(n=>n.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
      return value.replace(/(rgba?\()(\d+),(\d+),(\d+)/,(_,prefix,r,g,b)=>prefix+orange(r,g,b).join(','));
    }
    return bullet.color!=='blue'?value:value.startsWith('#')
      ? '#'+value.slice(3,5)+value.slice(5,7)+value.slice(1,3)
      : value.replace(/(rgba?\()(\d+),(\d+),(\d+)/, '$1$3,$4,$2');
  };
  // Skip the whole effect once both its head and longest wake have left the canvas.
  const reach=radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio+s.bloomRadiusScale);
  const screenX=bullet.x-camera.x,screenY=bullet.y-camera.y;
  if(context.canvas&&(screenX+reach<0||screenY+reach<0||screenX-reach>context.canvas.width||screenY-reach>context.canvas.height))return;
  context.save();context.translate(bullet.x-camera.x,bullet.y-camera.y);context.rotate(bullet.angle);
  const fade=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(duration-bullet.age)/.06))*Math.min(1,bullet.age/s.fadeInSeconds);
  // Only leave a wake along positions reached after acceleration, never behind the muzzle.
  const wakeAge=bullet.accelerating?Math.max(0,bullet.age-s.accelerationSeconds):bullet.age;
  context.globalAlpha=fade;
  context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  // A broad soft halo and a tighter luminous rim keep small shots bright without enlarging their core.
  const halo=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,radius*3.6);

// A full new run clears session state and generates a new local-time-based seed.
document.querySelector('#new-game').addEventListener('click', () => {
  const url = new URL(window.location.href);
  url.searchParams.set('seed', 'random');
  if (url.href === window.location.href) window.location.reload();
  else window.location.assign(url.href);
});

  const url = new URL(window.location.href);
  url.searchParams.set('seed', '0');
  if (url.href === window.location.href) window.location.reload();
  else window.location.assign(url.href);
});

/** Load a sheet before animation begins and report an actionable loading error. */
async function loadSheet(character) {
  if (character.gifFrames) {
    await loadGifAnimation(character);
    const actions=character.label==='Arisu Boss'?{charge:bossActionFrames.arisuCharge}:
      character.label==='Neru Boss'?{shoot:bossActionFrames.neruShoot}:{};
    character.actionAnimations={};
    await Promise.all(Object.entries(actions).map(async ([name,gifFrames])=>{
      const clip={gifFrames};await loadGifAnimation(clip);character.actionAnimations[name]=clip.animationFrames;
    }));
    return;
  }
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = () => {
      character.image = image;
      resolve();
        const enabled=!event.target.checked;
        umbrellaAttack.setAutoattackEnabled(enabled);
        arisAttack.setAutoattackEnabled(enabled);
        luminousAttack.setAutoattackEnabled(enabled);
        princessAttack.setAutoattackEnabled(enabled);
      });
      // Generate one testing button per implemented synergy, without requiring MAX ingredients.
      for(const recipe of synergyRecipes) {
        const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';
        button.textContent=`Equip ${recipe.result.name}`;
        button.addEventListener('click',()=>{
          const player=characters[selected];player.attackSlots??=[];
          if(player.attackSlots.some(item=>item?.id===recipe.result.id))return;
          let index=player.attackSlots.findIndex(item=>!item);
          if(index<0)index=player.attackSlots.length;
          if(index>=6){status.textContent='No empty weapon slot available.';return;}
          const weapon=recipe.createWeapon?recipe.createWeapon():{...recipe.result};
          player.attackSlots[index]={...weapon,level:1,isSynergy:true,consumedWeaponIds:[...recipe.ingredients]};
          hud.update(player);
        });
        document.querySelector('#admin-equip-synergies').append(button);
      }
      document.querySelector('#admin-equip-luminous').addEventListener('click',()=>{
        const player=characters[selected];if(getLuminousNova(player))return;
        player.attackSlots??=[];const empty=player.attackSlots.findIndex(item=>!item);
        if(empty>=0)player.attackSlots[empty]=createLuminousNovaWeapon();
        else if(player.attackSlots.length<6)player.attackSlots.push(createLuminousNovaWeapon());
        hud.update(player);
      });
      document.querySelector('#admin-equip-aris').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const player = characters[selected];
        if (getArisWeapon(player)) return;
        player.attackSlots ??= [];
        const empty = player.attackSlots.findIndex(item => !item);
        if (empty >= 0) player.attackSlots[empty] = createArisWeapon();
        else if (player.attackSlots.length < 6) player.attackSlots.push(createArisWeapon());
        hud.update(player);
      });
      document.querySelector('#admin-reset-cooldowns').addEventListener('click', () => skillCasting.resetCooldowns());

      }
      playerStatsTools = createPlayerStatsTools(() => characters[selected], character => hud.update(character));
      hud.update(characters[selected]);
      npcTools = createNpcTools({ canvas, characters, camera,
        getPlayer: () => characters[selected],
        getEliteChance: () => endlessMode || endlessBuildup.active ? endlessBuildup.eliteChance : undefined,
        getSurvivalSeconds: () => survivalClock.seconds,
        getInternalSeconds: () => campaignSchedule.seconds + (endlessMode ? Math.max(0, survivalClock.seconds - endlessStartedAt) : 0), getEventStage: () => campaignSchedule.stage,
        getCampaignSpawn: () => campaignSettings.enabled ? (pickEndlessEnemy(campaignSchedule.seconds + (endlessMode ? Math.max(0, survivalClock.seconds - endlessStartedAt) : 0)) || campaignSchedule.pickSpawn()) : null,
        campaignActive: () => campaignSettings.enabled,
        getCampaignProfile: type => campaignSettings.enabled && !endlessMode ? campaignSchedule.profileFor(type) : null,
        getStageId: () => currentMap, getStageSeconds: () => survivalClock.seconds-stageEnteredAt,
        timedSpawnsEnabled: () => Boolean(playtestSpawner?.running),
        getEndlessSeconds: () => endlessMode ? Math.max(0, survivalClock.seconds - endlessStartedAt) : null,
        getPlayerDamage: () => Math.max(1, Math.round(umbrellaSettings.damage * umbrellaSettings.damageMultiplier * umbrellaLevelStats(characters[selected]).damageMultiplier * statMultiplier(characters[selected], 'atkPercent'))),
        isVertical: () => maps[currentMap].axis === 'vertical',
        isFreeScroll: () => currentMap === 'third' || currentMap === 'fourth',
        isPlacementClear: (character, x, y) => currentMap === 'fourth'

          playableBounds: stripMapBounds(maps[currentMap], canvas.width, canvas.height, topMovementPadding, bottomMovementPadding) };
        stage.availableSides = offscreenSpawnSides(stage, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        return stage;
      };
      playtestSpawner = createPlaytestSpawner({ canvas, camera,
        getStage: getSpawnStage,
        getSpawnRate: rate => endlessMode || endlessBuildup.active ? endlessBuildup.spawnRate(rate) : rate,
        spawnEnemy: (x, y) => npcTools.spawnEnemy(x, y, endlessBuildup.spawnType, endlessBuildup.spawnEventKey), slotsRemaining: npcTools.slotsRemaining,
        onBatch: npcTools.refresh, getEnemies: npcTools.getEnemies, getPlayer: () => characters[selected] });
      // Event shortcuts start the stream immediately; stop returns to ordinary arrivals.
      for (const button of document.querySelectorAll('[data-dev-event]')) {
        button.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const status = document.querySelector('#event-test-status');
          const id = button.dataset.devEvent;
          if (id === 'end') {
            endlessBuildup.end();
            status.textContent = 'Event ended. Its enemies die without drops; ordinary spawning resumes.';
            return;
          }
          if (id === 'stop') {
            endlessBuildup.stop();
            playtestSpawner.setRunning(false);
            status.textContent = 'Event stopped; random spawning paused.';
            return;
          }
          if (getAllEnemies().some(isBossEnemy) || bossSpawner?.hasPendingWave) {
            status.textContent = 'Remove or defeat the active boss wave before testing an event.';
            return;
          }
          endlessBuildup.trigger(id);
          playtestSpawner.setRunning(true);
          status.textContent = `${endlessBuildup.name} started. Admin seed 0 still uses 1 HP.`;
        });
      }
      bossSpawner = createBossSpawner({ canvas, camera, getStage: getSpawnStage,
        getSurvivalSeconds: () => survivalClock.seconds, automaticEnabled: () => Boolean(playtestSpawner?.running),
        getEndlessSeconds: () => endlessMode ? Math.max(0, survivalClock.seconds - endlessStartedAt) : null,
        spawnBoss: npcTools.spawnBoss, slotsRemaining: npcTools.slotsRemaining,
        canSpawnWave: () => !(campaignSettings.enabled && !endlessMode) && !pendingStageTransition && (!(endlessMode || endlessBuildup.active) || endlessBuildup.allowsBossWave),
        onSpawn: npcTools.refresh, isEndless: () => endlessMode,
        getBossTypes: () => Object.keys(characters).filter(type => characters[type].boss) });
      onEnemyDefeat(({ enemy }) => {
        crafters?.roll(enemy);
        goldenCrafters?.roll(enemy);
        gachaFiles?.roll(enemy);
        runScore.recordDefeat(enemy);
        campaignSchedule.recordDefeat(enemy);
        if(pendingStageTransition) return;
        if(campaignSettings.enabled && !endlessMode) {
          if(!campaignSchedule.readyToAdvance) return;
        } else if(!bossWaveIsDefeated(enemy,getAllEnemies(),bossSpawner.hasPendingWave)) return;
        advanceStageAfterClear();
      });
      levelUpMenu = createLevelUpMenu({ canvas, getPlayer: () => characters[selected],
        isPauseMenuOpen: () => Boolean(pauseMenu?.paused || crafters?.active || goldenCrafters?.active || gachaFiles?.active), releaseControls,
        onOpen: () => skillCasting?.cancel('levelup'),
        onChoose: player => { hud.update(player); playerStatsTools.update(); }
      });
      pauseMenu = createPauseMenu({ canvas, isBlocked: () => Boolean(levelUpMenu?.active || crafters?.active || goldenCrafters?.active || gachaFiles?.active), getPlayer: () => characters[selected], releaseControls,
        onPause: () => skillCasting?.cancel('pause') });
      document.querySelector('#run-seed-status').textContent = `Run seed: ${runSeed} | Started: ${runStartedAt.toLocaleString()}`;
      window.pageLoading?.finish();
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    })
    .catch(error => { status.textContent = error.message; window.pageLoading?.fail('Unable to load game assets. Please reload to try again.'); });
}

/** Continuous same-direction movement, measured once per simulation tick, not per boss. */
export function createSteadyMovementTracker() {
  let owner=null,seconds=0,heading=null,vx=0,vy=0;
  return {update(delta,player,motion={x:0,y:0}) {
    if(delta<=0)return;
    if(owner!==player){owner=player;seconds=0;heading=null;}
    const length=Math.hypot(motion.x||0,motion.y||0);
    if(length<.01){seconds=0;heading=null;vx=vy=0;return;}
    const direction={x:motion.x/length,y:motion.y/length};
    if(!heading||direction.x*heading.x+direction.y*heading.y<.995){seconds=0;heading=direction;}
    seconds+=delta;vx=motion.x/delta;vy=motion.y/delta;
  },get seconds(){return seconds;},get velocity(){return {x:vx,y:vy};}};
}

    return false;
  }

export function neruBodyCenterOffsetY(character) {

function updateCharacter(character, delta, direction, chaseTarget) {
  if (character.attack) {
    character.attack.elapsed += delta * 1000;
    const attack = character.attacks[character.attack.name];
    const frames = character.layout.columnEdges.length - 1;
    if (character.attack.elapsed >= frames * attack.frameDuration) {
      const walkElapsed = character.attack.walkElapsed;
      beginPoseTransition(character);
      character.attack = null;
      character.elapsed = walkElapsed;
      updateAttackControls();
    } else {
      return;
    }
  }
  character.moving = Boolean(direction);
  if (!direction) {
    character.elapsed = 0;
    return;
  }

  // Arona turns at the current stride phase rather than snapping to frame zero.
  if (character.direction !== direction && !character.preserveWalkPhase) {
    character.elapsed = 0;
  }
  character.direction = direction;
  if (character.horizontalFacingOnly) {
    const horizontal = directionVectors[direction][0];
    if (horizontal) {
      const facing = horizontal > 0 ? 'right' : 'left';
      if (facing !== character.facing) beginPoseTransition(character);
      character.facing = facing;
    }
  }
  character.elapsed += delta * 1000;
  // Chase uses the precise center-to-center vector; facing stays eight-way.
  const [x, y] = chaseTarget
    ? [chaseTarget.x - character.x, chaseTarget.y - character.y]
    : directionVectors[direction];
  const length = Math.hypot(x, y);
  const baseSpeed = movementSpeed * (character.movementSpeedMultiplier || 1) * statMultiplier(character, 'spdPercent');
  const step = Math.max(baseSpeed, character.catchupSpeed || 0) * delta;
  const distance = (chaseTarget ? Math.min(step, length) : step) / (length || 1);
  const previousX = character.x;
  const previousY = character.y;
  character.x += x * distance;
  character.y += y * distance;
  if (chaseTarget && step >= length) {
    character.x = chaseTarget.x;
    character.y = chaseTarget.y;
  }
  const isEnemy = character !== characters[selected];
  // Boss bodies can cross props, shoreline, and strip edges while pursuing the player.
  if (isEnemy && isBossEnemy(character)) return;
  if (character.harmlessEscaping || character.behavior === 'horde') return; // Escape animations may cross the shoreline/walls to leave view.
  if (currentMap === 'fourth') {
    const resolved = resolveIslandMotion(character, previousX, previousY, character.x, character.y, maps.fourth, isEnemy);
    character.x = resolved.x;
    character.y = resolved.y;
    return;
  }
  if (maps[currentMap].axis === 'both') {
    if (isEnemy) return; // Enemies cross props; the player still collides normally.
    const resolved = resolveObstacleMotion(character, previousX, previousY, character.x, character.y);
    character.x = resolved.x;
    character.y = resolved.y;
    return;
  }
  if (currentMap === 'first' && !isEnemy) {
    const resolved = resolveOfficeMotion(character, previousX, previousY, character.x, character.y, maps.first, canvas.height);
    character.x = resolved.x;
    character.y = resolved.y;
  }
  if (currentMap === 'second' && !isEnemy) {
    const resolved = resolvePalaceMotion(character, previousX, previousY, character.x, character.y, maps.second, canvas.width);
    character.x = resolved.x;
    character.y = resolved.y;
  }
  // Neither map's locked-axis limits should interrupt diagonal input while the
  // backgrounds are changing. Apply destination walls only after the ripple.
  // Existing outside positions are preserved by constrainWithoutTeleport below.
  if (mapTransition?.active) return;
  const margin = (character.spriteSize || spriteSize) / 2;
  const bounds = stripMapBounds(maps[currentMap], canvas.width, canvas.height, topMovementPadding, bottomMovementPadding);
  // X is an unbounded world position, not a canvas position. Never wrap it:
  // future enemy positions must remain stable when background tiles disappear.
  if (maps[currentMap].axis === 'horizontal') {
    character.y = constrainWithoutTeleport(previousY, character.y, bounds.top + margin, bounds.bottom - margin);
  } else {
    character.x = constrainWithoutTeleport(previousX, character.x, bounds.left + margin, bounds.right - margin);
  }
}

/** Boss identity is explicit, never inferred from an elite's enlarged sprite. */
export function isBossEnemy(enemy) {
  if(enemy.boss === false) return false;
  return enemy.boss === true || enemy.type === 'iroha' || enemy.type === 'shiroko';
}

/** Render special enemies above normal actors, while bosses always own the final layer. */
export function enemyRenderLayer(enemy) {
  if (isBossEnemy(enemy)) return 'boss';
  return enemy.special === true || enemy.type === 'yuuka' ? 'special' : 'normal';

## My request:
Tuning Parts are pickups that are randomly dropped by enemies. They provide various perks to the character's starting weapon (and only the starting weapon). Tuning Parts can be strengthened up to two times, by consuming other Tuning Parts, to provide an even larger boost.

Yuukas are guaranteed to drop a Stamp upon being defeated.


Mechanics
Enemies have a 1/780 chance to drop a stamp when they are defeated. When a stamp is found and picked up, it automatically pulls up the stamps menu, where the following actions can be done to a found stamp:

Equip it to the starting weapon, or swap it with an already equipped stamp.
Consume it to strengthen an already equipped stamp. The consumed stamp will not appear again for the duration of the battle.
Sell the stamp for a number of Credits. The sold stamp will not appear again for the duration of the battle.
Drop the stamp (without destroying it) by pressing Finish with the stamp still in the Found box. The stamp can then be picked up later. Stamps will retain their level when dropped.
Stamps can also be accessed and managed from the pause menu. Equipped stamps will have their icons appear on the upper left corner of the screen, to the right of the HP bar and the Item and Weapon icons.

Up to three stamps can be equipped to a weapon at a time and each stamp can be strengthened to a maximum level of 3. The amount of Credits gained from selling a stamp is affected by the level of the stamp, the stage's credit multiplier and the Credit Gain Up shop upgrade.

Note that using an upgraded stamp to strengthen another stamp will still only increase the level by 1.

/** Shared draw/contact rectangle, including the icon's scale and upward ground offset. */
export function crafterSpriteBounds(drop) {
  const scale=crafterSettings.iconScale;
  return {left:drop.x-18*scale,right:drop.x+18*scale,top:drop.y-46*scale,bottom:drop.y+scale};
}

/** Inclusive swept segment/rectangle test, so fast movement cannot skip a Crafter. */
function segmentTouchesRectangle(from,to,box) {
  let enter=0,exit=1;
  for(const [start,end,min,max] of [[from.x,to.x,box.left,box.right],[from.y,to.y,box.top,box.bottom]]) {
    const delta=end-start;
    if(Math.abs(delta)<1e-10){if(start<min||start>max)return false;continue;}
    const a=(min-start)/delta,b=(max-start)/delta;
    enter=Math.max(enter,Math.min(a,b));exit=Math.min(exit,Math.max(a,b));
    if(enter>exit)return false;
  }
  return true;
}

/** Sweep the real player ellipse against the visible icon, with rounded-corner accuracy. */
export function crafterTouchesPlayer(drop,player,previous=player,padding=0) {
  const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),from=getCombatHitbox({...player,x:previous.x,y:previous.y},false);
  const sprite=crafterSpriteBounds(drop);
  const box={left:sprite.left-padding,right:sprite.right+padding,top:sprite.top-padding,bottom:sprite.bottom+padding};

}

// EDIT attack balance and timing here. Interval is measured start to start:
// 1.5 seconds total = 0.2 seconds swinging + 1.3 seconds before the next swing.
const crop = { x: 100, y: 228, width: 68, height: 304 };

/** Ease into a swift central slash, then decelerate at the end of a 180Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â° sweep. */
export function umbrellaSwingAngle(aim, elapsed, duration = umbrellaSettings.duration) {
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, elapsed / duration));
  const eased = t < 0.5 ? 4 * t ** 3 : 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ** 3 / 2;
  const arc = umbrellaSettings.arcDegrees * Math.PI / 180;
  return aim - arc / 2 + eased * arc;
}

/** Test the swept blade sector so fast swings cannot skip enemies between frames. */
export function umbrellaHits(player, enemy, fromAngle, toAngle, areaScale = 1) {
  areaScale *= umbrellaSettings.sizeScale;
  const body = getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
  const dx = body.x - player.x, dy = body.y - player.y;
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const radius = Math.max(body.rx, body.ry);
  if (distance > umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale + radius) return false;
  if (distance + radius < umbrellaSettings.damageInnerRadius * areaScale) return false;
  // Subdivide the swept sector into blade segments at most 2 degrees apart.
  const samples = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.abs(toAngle - fromAngle) / (Math.PI / 90)));
  for (let i = 0; i <= samples; i++) {
    const angle = fromAngle + (toAngle - fromAngle) * i / samples;
    const x = Math.cos(angle), y = Math.sin(angle);
    if (segmentHitsBody(body,
      player.x + x * umbrellaSettings.damageInnerRadius * areaScale, player.y + y * umbrellaSettings.damageInnerRadius * areaScale,
      player.x + x * umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale, player.y + y * umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

import { umbrellaUpgradeSettings, umbrellaSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';

/** Locate Plana's equipped umbrella without selecting or switching active weapons. */
export function getUmbrella(player) {
  return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon => weapon?.id === 'plana-umbrella');
}

/** Cumulative weapon-level bonuses; awakening is a separate state after level seven. */
export function umbrellaLevelStats(player) {
  const level = Math.max(1, Math.min(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel, getUmbrella(player)?.level || 1));
  const damageTiers = Number(level >= 2) + Number(level >= 5);
  const areaTiers = Number(level >= 3) + Number(level >= 6);
  return {
    level, damageMultiplier: (1 + umbrellaUpgradeSettings.damageIncrease) ** damageTiers,
    areaScale: Math.sqrt(1 + areaTiers * umbrellaUpgradeSettings.areaIncrease),
    intervalMultiplier: level >= 4 ? umbrellaUpgradeSettings.intervalMultiplier : 1,
    guaranteedCritical: level >= 7,
    awakened: Boolean(getUmbrella(player)?.awakened)
  };
}

/** Nominal weapon damage only; all variation is applied after character ATK. */
export function umbrellaBaseDamage() {
  return umbrellaSettings.damage * umbrellaSettings.damageMultiplier;
}

/** Apply weapon upgrades first, then player ATK and the appropriate critical multiplier. */
export function rollUmbrellaDamage(player, base = umbrellaBaseDamage(), random = Math.random, damageMod = 1, target) {
  const stats = umbrellaLevelStats(player);
  const hit=rollAttackDamage(player, totalWeaponDamage(player, 'plana-umbrella', base / 10,
    [ (stats.damageMultiplier - 1) * 100 ], { projectileCount: 1, hitCooldownFrames: umbrellaSettings.hitCooldown * 60 }), random, {
    damageMod, target, forceCritical: stats.guaranteedCritical,
    criticalMultiplier: stats.guaranteedCritical ? umbrellaUpgradeSettings.finalCriticalMultiplier : undefined
  });
  if(stats.guaranteedCritical && hit.critical)hit.type='supercritical';
  return hit;
}

/** Add character and weapon critical damage bonuses; overrides replace only the base.
 * criticalMultiplier is an optional weapon base override (e.g. Umbrella LV7=3).
 * critDamagePercent contains accumulated bonuses, separate from critical chance.
 */
export function characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponBonus = 0) {
  const base = criticalMultiplier !== undefined ? (criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100 :
    (character.baseCritMod ?? (combatBalance.criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100);
  const bonus = ensureCombatStats(character).critDamagePercent;
  return Math.max(0, 1 + totalCritModFormula(base, [bonus, weaponBonus]) / 100);
}


/** Measure character-to-target world distance at the hit, never from projectile origin. */
export function characterHaloMultiplier(character, target) {
  if (!target || ![character.x, character.y, target.x, target.y].every(Number.isFinite)) return 1;
  return haloDamageFormula(Math.hypot(target.x - character.x, target.y - character.y), character.haloLevel ?? 0);
}

/** Roll per-hit critical chance; target debuffs add percentage points before clamping. */
export function rollAttackDamage(character, totalWeaponDamage, random = Math.random,
  { damageMod = 1, forceCritical = false, targetCritBonus = 0, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent = 0, target } = {}) {
  const stats = ensureCombatStats(character);
  const buffs=Object.values(character.combatBuffs||{}).filter(Boolean);
  const bonusCrit=buffs.reduce((sum,buff)=>sum+(Number(buff.critPercent)||0),0);
  const critical = forceCritical || random() < Math.max(0, Math.min(100, stats.critPercent + bonusCrit + targetCritBonus)) / 100;
  const combinedModifier = damageModifiersFormula({
    criticalMultiplier: critical ? characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent) : 1,
    bonusDamageTaken: bonusDamageTakenFormula(target?.bonusDamageTakenPercent ?? []),
    DB: damageBonusFormula([...stats.damageBonusMultipliers,...buffs.map(buff=>buff.damageBonusMultiplier).filter(Number.isFinite)]),
    DR: damageReductionFormula(target?.damageReductionPercent ?? []),
    halo: characterHaloMultiplier(character, target),
    attackModifier: damageMod // Attack-specific effects, including EX drawing accuracy.
  });
  return { damage: attackDamageFormula(totalWeaponDamage, totalCharacterATK(character), combinedModifier, random),
    critical, type: critical ? 'critical' : 'normal' };
}

/** Build weapon damage with independent level bonuses and optional purchased Growth.
 * mainWeaponId can explicitly identify a character main weapon; Plana defaults to her umbrella.
 */
export function totalWeaponDamage(character, weaponId, base, bonusesPercent = [], options = {}) {
  const mainWeaponId = character.mainWeaponId ?? (character.label === 'Plana' ? 'plana-umbrella' : null);
  const weapon=character.attackSlots?.find(item=>item?.id===weaponId);
  return weaponDamageFormula(base, bonusesPercent, {
    ...options, enhancementRank:weapon?.enhancementRank ?? 0, growthEligible: weaponId === mainWeaponId,
    growthRank: character.growthRank ?? growthSettings.defaultRank, playerLevel: character.level ?? 1
  });
}

/** Build weapon damage with independent level bonuses and optional purchased Growth.
 * mainWeaponId can explicitly identify a character main weapon; Plana defaults to her umbrella.
 */
export function totalWeaponDamage(character, weaponId, base, bonusesPercent = [], options = {}) {
  const mainWeaponId = character.mainWeaponId ?? (character.label === 'Plana' ? 'plana-umbrella' : null);
  const weapon=character.attackSlots?.find(item=>item?.id===weaponId);
  return weaponDamageFormula(base, bonusesPercent, {
    ...options, enhancementRank:weapon?.enhancementRank ?? 0, growthEligible: weaponId === mainWeaponId,
    growthRank: character.growthRank ?? growthSettings.defaultRank, playerLevel: character.level ?? 1
  });
}

/** Apply weapon upgrades first, then player ATK and the appropriate critical multiplier. */
export function rollUmbrellaDamage(player, base = umbrellaBaseDamage(), random = Math.random, damageMod = 1, target) {
  const stats = umbrellaLevelStats(player);
  const hit=rollAttackDamage(player, totalWeaponDamage(player, 'plana-umbrella', base / 10,
    [ (stats.damageMultiplier - 1) * 100 ], { projectileCount: 1, hitCooldownFrames: umbrellaSettings.hitCooldown * 60 }), random, {

    criticalMultiplier: stats.guaranteedCritical ? umbrellaUpgradeSettings.finalCriticalMultiplier : undefined
  });

  return hit;
}

    const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='pause-stat-row';

    const labelCanvas=document.createElement('canvas'),valueCanvas=document.createElement('canvas');
    const labelText=createBitmapText(labelCanvas,{variant:'font2',scale:1.1*scale});
    const valueText=createBitmapText(valueCanvas,{variant:'font2',scale:1.1*scale});
    labelText.setText(label);row.append(icon,labelCanvas,valueCanvas);rowsContainer.append(row);
    return {value,valueText};
  });
  return {
    /** Read the current character each time a menu opens; never reuse stale HP or bonuses. */
    update(player) {
      const character=ensurePlayerStats(player);name.setText(character.label||'Character');
      for(const row of rows)row.valueText.setText(row.value(character));
      const label=String(character.label||'').toLowerCase();
      const source=label.includes('plana')?'../sprites/Plana_Portrait.png':label.includes('arona')?'../sprites/Arona_Portrait.png':'';
      portrait.hidden=!source;if(source)portrait.src=source;
    }
  };
}
import {createTuningRun,tuningPartCatalog,rollTuningPart,equipTuningPart,strengthenTuningPart,tuningSellValue} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {safeDropLanding,gainCredits} from './exp-drops.js';
import {getCombatHitbox,segmentHitsBody} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import {createBitmapText} from './bitmap-font.js';
export function createTuningSystem({canvas,getPlayer:getCharacter,onOpen=()=>{},onChange=()=>{}}){
  const run=createTuningRun(),drops=[],images=new Map();let active=false,found=null,selected=0,ignored=null;
  const root=document.createElement('section');root.className='tuning-menu';root.hidden=true;root.setAttribute('aria-label','Tuning Parts');
  canvas.parentElement.append(root);
  const hud=document.createElement('div');hud.className='tuning-hud';canvas.parentElement.append(hud);
  const getPlayer=()=>{const player=getCharacter();player.tuningParts=run;return player;};
  getPlayer();
  const definition=part=>tuningPartCatalog.find(p=>p.id===part?.id);
  function label(parent,text){const c=document.createElement('canvas');parent.append(c);createBitmapText(c,{variant:'font2',scale:1,wrap:false}).setText(text);}
  function button(parent,text,action,disabled=false){const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.disabled=disabled;b.setAttribute('aria-label',text);label(b,text);b.onclick=action;parent.append(b);return b;}
  function icon(parent,part){const d=definition(part);if(d?.icon){const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=d.icon;img.alt=d.name;parent.append(img);}}
  function updateHud(){hud.replaceChildren();for(const part of run.equipped){if(!part)continue;const slot=document.createElement('div');icon(slot,part);slot.title=`${definition(part)?.name} LV ${part.level}`;hud.append(slot);}}
  function spawn(x,y,part){const point=safeDropLanding(x,y);if(!point)return false;const drop={...point,part:{...part}};drops.push(drop);return drop;}
  function finish(){if(found){const p=getPlayer();ignored=spawn(p.x,p.y,found);found=null;}active=false;root.hidden=true;onChange();canvas.focus({preventScroll:true});}
  function render(){root.replaceChildren();label(root,'TUNING PARTS');label(root,'Starting weapon only');
    const slots=document.createElement('div');slots.className='tuning-slots';root.append(slots);
    run.equipped.forEach((part,i)=>{const b=button(slots,part?`${definition(part)?.name||part.id} LV ${part.level}`:'Empty',()=>{selected=i;render();});icon(b,part);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(i===selected));});
    const target=run.equipped[selected];label(root,`Found: ${definition(found)?.name||'None'}${found?` LV ${found.level}`:''}`);icon(root,found);
    const copy=document.createElement('p');copy.textContent=definition(found||target)?.levels?.[(found||target)?.level-1]?.description||(!tuningPartCatalog.length?'Tuning Part definitions have not been added yet.':'Select a slot to manage.');root.append(copy);
    button(root,target?'Swap':'Equip',()=>{const result=equipTuningPart(run,found,selected);if(result.ok)found=result.previous;updateHud();onChange();render();},!found);
    button(root,'Strengthen',()=>{if(strengthenTuningPart(run,found,selected)){found=null;updateHud();onChange();render();}},!found||!target||target.level>=3);
    if(!found&&target)run.equipped.forEach((source,index)=>{
      if(index===selected||!source)return;
      button(root,`Consume ${definition(source)?.name||source.id} to strengthen selected`,()=>{
        if(strengthenTuningPart(run,source,selected)){run.equipped[index]=null;updateHud();onChange();render();}
      },target.level>=3);
    });
    const selling=found||target,value=selling?tuningSellValue(selling,getPlayer()):null;
    button(root,`Sell${value===null?'':` (${value} Credits)`}`,()=>{run.excluded.add(selling.id);gainCredits(value);if(found)found=null;else run.equipped[selected]=null;updateHud();onChange();render();},!selling||value===null);
    button(root,'Drop equipped',()=>{if(!target)return;const p=getPlayer();const drop=spawn(p.x,p.y,target);if(drop){ignored=drop;run.equipped[selected]=null;updateHud();onChange();render();}},!target);
    button(root,'Finish',finish);
  }
  function open(part=null){if(active)return;found=part;active=true;onOpen();render();root.hidden=false;root.querySelector('button')?.focus({preventScroll:true});}
  root.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>e.preventDefault());root.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(e.button===2){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();finish();}});
  root.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();finish();}});
  return {run,get active(){return active;},open,spawn,
    roll(enemy,random=Math.random){const part=rollTuningPart(run,enemy,random,tuningPartCatalog.filter(part=>!drops.some(drop=>drop.part.id===part.id)));return part?spawn(enemy.x,enemy.y,part):false;},
    clear(){drops.length=0;ignored=null;},
    update(player,previous=player){player.tuningParts=run;if(active)return;const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),from=getCombatHitbox({...player,x:previous.x,y:previous.y},false);
      for(let i=0;i<drops.length;i++){const d=drops[i],shape={x:d.x,y:d.y-12,rx:18,ry:18};if(d===ignored){if(!segmentHitsBody(shape,body.x,body.y,body.x,body.y))ignored=null;continue;}
        if(segmentHitsBody({...shape,rx:18+body.rx,ry:18+body.ry},from.x,from.y,body.x,body.y)){drops.splice(i,1);open(d.part);break;}}
    },
    draw(ctx,camera){for(const drop of drops){const d=definition(drop.part);if(!d?.icon)continue;let img=images.get(d.icon);if(!img){img=new Image();img.src=d.icon;images.set(d.icon,img);}if(img.complete&&img.naturalWidth)ctx.drawImage(img,drop.x-camera.x-15,drop.y-camera.y-27,30,30);}}
  };
}

/** Crop/rotate the actual inventory icon, matching the HUD rather than stretching a sheet. */
function inventoryIcon(target) {
  const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=canvas.height=128;
  canvas.className='crafter-inventory-icon';canvas.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  applyEnhancedWeaponGlow(canvas,target);
  if(!target?.icon)return canvas;
  if(drawSynergyIcon(canvas,target))return canvas;
  const image=new Image();
  image.onload=()=>{
    const crop=target.iconCrop||{x:0,y:0,width:image.naturalWidth,height:image.naturalHeight};
    const angle=(target.iconRotation||0)*Math.PI/180;
    const width=Math.abs(crop.width*Math.cos(angle))+Math.abs(crop.height*Math.sin(angle));
    const height=Math.abs(crop.width*Math.sin(angle))+Math.abs(crop.height*Math.cos(angle));
    const scale=116/Math.max(width,height),context=canvas.getContext('2d');
    context.save();context.translate(64,64);context.rotate(angle);
    context.drawImage(image,crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height,-crop.width*scale/2,-crop.height*scale/2,crop.width*scale,crop.height*scale);context.restore();
  };
  image.src=target.icon;return canvas;
}

  for(let i=0;i<pixels.data.length;i+=4)if(pixels.data[i]>160&&pixels.data[i+1]>160&&pixels.data[i+2]>160) {
    pixels.data[i]=255;pixels.data[i+1]=225;pixels.data[i+2]=90;
  }
  context.putImageData(pixels,0,0);highlightedGlyphs.set(key,tile);return tile;
}

/** Return tight glyph bounds so only the dark outlines meet between letters. */
export function glyphRectangle(character) {
  return fontMetrics[character] || fontMetrics['?'];
}

/** Render crisp HUD text from the supplied font sheet, refreshing only on changes. */
export function createBitmapText(canvas, { scale = 2, outlineOverlap = 1, spaceWidth = 3, fitWidth = null, variant = 'regular', maxWidth = null, wrap = true, highlightStats = false } = {}) {
  const image = new Image();
  let loaded = false;
  let text = '';
  const sourceScale = variant === 'font21' ? .25 : 1;
  const lineHeight = variant === 'font21' ? 24 : 20;
  const glyphFor = character => variant === 'font21' ? font21Metrics[character] || font21Metrics['?'] : variant === 'font2' ? font2Metrics[character] || font2Metrics['?'] : variant === 'thin' ? thinFontMetrics[character] || thinFontMetrics['?'] : glyphRectangle(character);

  function render() {
    // EDIT scale/outlineOverlap via options: 2x glyphs, one source outline pixel overlap.
    const lines = [''];
    const measure = value => [...value].reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(c).width * sourceScale - outlineOverlap), outlineOverlap) * scale;
    for (const word of text.split(' ')) {
      const index = lines.length - 1;
      const next = lines[index] ? `${lines[index]} ${word}` : word;
      if (wrap && maxWidth && lines[index] && measure(next) > maxWidth) lines.push(word);
      else lines[index] = next;
    }
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, ...lines.map(measure));
    canvas.height = lineHeight * scale * lines.length;
    canvas.style.width = fitWidth || `${canvas.width}px`;
    canvas.style.height = fitWidth ? 'auto' : `${canvas.height}px`;
    canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', text);
    if (!loaded) return;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    lines.forEach((line, row) => {
      let x = 0,index=0;const highlights=highlightStats?statHighlightRanges(line):[];
      for (const character of line) {
        if (character !== ' ') {
          const glyph = glyphFor(character);
          const highlighted=highlights.some(range=>index>=range.start&&index<range.end);
          const source=highlighted?yellowGlyph(image,glyph,variant,character):image;
          context.drawImage(source, highlighted?0:glyph.x, highlighted?0:glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
            x * scale, (row * lineHeight + glyph.offsetY * sourceScale) * scale, glyph.width * sourceScale * scale, glyph.height * sourceScale * scale);
        }
        x += character === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(character).width * sourceScale - outlineOverlap;
        index+=character.length;
      }
    });
  }

  image.onload = () => { loaded = true; render(); };
  image.src = new URL(variant === 'font21' ? '../sprites/font2.1.png' : variant === 'font2' ? '../sprites/font2.png' : variant === 'thin' ? '../sprites/font-thin.png' : '../sprites/font.png', import.meta.url).href;
  return {
    setMaxWidth(value) { maxWidth = value; render(); },
    setText(value) {
      if (text === value) return;
      text = value;
      render();
    }
  };
}

/** Steady white ground glow and soft cyan-white pillar; purely visual, with no flashing. */
export function drawCrafterGlow(context,x,y,golden=false) {
  const glow=crafterSettings.glow;
  context.save();context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';context.globalAlpha=glow.opacity;
  if(golden)context.filter='sepia(1) saturate(4)';
  // Stretch a radial falloff into a narrow pillar, extending below and above the icon.
  context.save();context.translate(x,y-glow.pillarHeight*.45);
  context.scale(glow.pillarWidth/(glow.pillarHeight+24),1);
  const pillar=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,glow.pillarHeight*.6);
  pillar.addColorStop(0,'rgba(235,255,255,.6)');pillar.addColorStop(.35,'rgba(135,245,255,.32)');pillar.addColorStop(1,'rgba(100,235,255,0)');
  context.fillStyle=pillar;context.fillRect(-glow.pillarHeight,-glow.pillarHeight,glow.pillarHeight*2,glow.pillarHeight*2);context.restore();
  const core=context.createLinearGradient(0,y-glow.pillarHeight,0,y+8);
  core.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');core.addColorStop(.3,'rgba(235,255,255,.12)');core.addColorStop(.85,'rgba(255,255,255,.45)');core.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
  context.fillStyle=core;context.fillRect(x-3,y-glow.pillarHeight,6,glow.pillarHeight+8);
  // Flatten the base into a luminous pool of light on the ground.
  context.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,glow.opacity*1.2);
  context.translate(x,y+2);context.scale(1,.32);
  const base=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,glow.baseRadius);
  base.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,.95)');base.addColorStop(.3,'rgba(255,255,255,.65)');base.addColorStop(.65,'rgba(150,245,255,.3)');base.addColorStop(1,'rgba(120,235,255,0)');
  context.fillStyle=base;context.fillRect(-glow.baseRadius,-glow.baseRadius,glow.baseRadius*2,glow.baseRadius*2);
  context.restore();
}

/** Always-visible pickup marker, pointing toward the drop at viewport edges. */
export function drawCrafterMarker(context,x,y,width,height,golden=false) {
      const offscreen=x<20||x>width-20||y<20||y>height-20;
      let ax=x,ay=Math.max(28,y-crafterSettings.glow.pillarHeight-18),angle=Math.PI/2;
      if(offscreen) {
        const dx=x-width/2,dy=y-height/2;
        const scale=Math.min((width/2-30)/Math.max(.001,Math.abs(dx)),(height/2-30)/Math.max(.001,Math.abs(dy)));
        ax=width/2+dx*scale;ay=height/2+dy*scale;angle=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
      }
      context.save();context.translate(ax,ay);context.rotate(angle);context.fillStyle=golden?'#ffeaa0':'#fff';context.strokeStyle=golden?'#b88b20':'#1d719c';context.lineWidth=2;
      // Local +X is the tip; rotation points down at visible Crafters or toward offscreen ones.
      context.beginPath();context.moveTo(22,0);context.lineTo(-14,-17);context.lineTo(-14,17);context.closePath();context.fill();context.stroke();context.restore();
}

export function equipTuningPart(run,part,index){
  if(!part||!Number.isInteger(index)||index<0||index>=3||run.equipped.some((p,i)=>i!==index&&p?.id===part.id))return {ok:false};

}
export function strengthenTuningPart(run,consumed,index){
  const target=run.equipped[index];if(!target||!consumed||target===consumed||target.level>=3)return false;

}

/** Apply damage and trigger a brief sprite pulse; remove defeated test enemies. */
export function damageEnemy(id, amount, source, hitType = 'normal', options = {}) {
  const enemy = enemies.get(id);
  if (!enemy || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
  if (options.instantKO && (isBossEnemy(enemy) || enemy.miniBoss || enemy.instantKOImmune)) return false;
  if (options.canMiss && midoriDodges(enemy, source)) {
    showDamageNumber(enemy, 0, false, 'miss');
    return false;
  }
  const harmless = ['yuuka','sensei'].includes(enemy.type);
  if (harmless) {
    dropYuukaCredits(enemy); // Each accepted hit, including the final hit.
    enemy.receivedHits = (enemy.receivedHits || 0) + 1;
  }
  const requiredHits = harmless ? (enemy.hitsToDefeat ?? harmlessEnemySettings[`${enemy.type}HitsToDefeat`]) : null;
  const actualDamage=Math.min(enemy.hp,amount);
  enemy.hp = Math.max(0, enemy.hp - amount);
  for(const listener of damageListeners)listener({enemy,source,damage:actualDamage,requestedDamage:amount,hitType});
  // Count accepted hits, not damage points; misses and rejected hits never reach this branch.
  if (Number.isFinite(requiredHits) && requiredHits >= 1 && enemy.receivedHits >= requiredHits) enemy.hp = 0;
  showDamageNumber(enemy, amount, false, hitType, options.damageGroup); // Include overkill and crit styling.
  enemy.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
  if (enemy.hp === 0) {
    const bossesAliveBefore = [...enemies.values()].filter(isBossEnemy).length;
    killCount++;
    dropEnemyExp(enemy);
    dropEnemyLoot(enemy);
    beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source);
    enemies.delete(id);
    for (const listener of defeatListeners) listener({ enemy, bossesAliveBefore });
  }
  return enemy;
}

import { knockbackSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';

/** Age resistance in gameplay seconds, retaining any configured base resistance. */
export function updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, delta) {
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds === undefined) return;
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds += Math.max(0, delta);
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds >= knockbackSettings.resetSeconds - 1e-8) enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
}

/** Scale speed by existing resistance, then add a stack for subsequent knockbacks. */
export function beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, duration, { ignoreKnockbackResistance = false } = {}) {
  // Absolute immunity also blocks attacks that bypass resistance.
  if (enemy.knockbackImmune || !(duration > 0) || !(Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 0)) return null;
  updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, 0);
  const resistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
  const scale = ignoreKnockbackResistance ? 1 : 1 - resistance;
  enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.round(((enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0) + knockbackSettings.resistancePerHit) * 1e6) / 1e6);
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus);
  return { dx: dx * scale, dy: dy * scale, duration, elapsed: 0, applied: 0, stopped: false };
}

import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';

/** Stun independently of displacement, respecting knockback resistance and absolute immunity. */
export function applySkillControl(enemy, dx, dy, stunSeconds, travelSeconds, options = {}) {
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining || 0, stunSeconds);
  enemy.skillKnockback = beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, travelSeconds, options);
  enemy.contactReaction = null; enemy.attack = null; enemy.moving = false;
}

/** Resolve stun before AI/contact so a stunned enemy cannot move or damage the player. */
export function updateEnemyControl(enemy, delta, move) {
  const stunned = enemy.stunRemaining > 0;
  if (!stunned && !enemy.skillKnockback) return false;
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(0, (enemy.stunRemaining || 0) - delta);
  if (enemy.stunRemaining < 1e-6) enemy.stunRemaining = 0;
  const knockback = enemy.skillKnockback;
  if (knockback) {
    if (!advanceKnockback(enemy, knockback, delta, move)) delete enemy.skillKnockback;
  }
  if (stunned) enemy.moving = false;
  return stunned;
}

/** Detect player pass-through with a swept segment rather than endpoint overlap only. */
function contactGeometry(npc, player, motion) {
  const enemyBody = getCombatHitbox(npc, true), playerBody = getCombatHitbox(player, false);
  const rx = enemyBody.rx + playerBody.rx, ry = enemyBody.ry + playerBody.ry;
  const fromX = playerBody.x - motion.x, fromY = playerBody.y - motion.y;
  const lengthSquared = motion.x * motion.x + motion.y * motion.y;
  const scaledLength = (motion.x / rx) ** 2 + (motion.y / ry) ** 2;
  const t = scaledLength ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    ((enemyBody.x - fromX) * motion.x / rx ** 2 +
      (enemyBody.y - fromY) * motion.y / ry ** 2) / scaledLength)) : 1;

  const dy = enemyBody.y - (fromY + motion.y * t);
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const pushing = lengthSquared > 0.0001 &&
    motion.x * (npc.x - fromX) + motion.y * (npc.y - fromY) > 0;
  // At exact overlap, push along player travel; otherwise away from the player.
  const fallbackLength = Math.hypot(motion.x, motion.y) || 1;
  const nx = distance > 0.001 ? dx / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.x / fallbackLength : 1;

/** Measure distance from sprite edges to the gameplay viewport rectangle. */
export function enemyViewportDistance(enemy, camera, width, height) {
  const radius = (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2;
  const dx = Math.max(camera.x - (enemy.x + radius), enemy.x - radius - camera.x - width, 0);
  const dy = Math.max(camera.y - (enemy.y + radius), enemy.y - radius - camera.y - height, 0);
  return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
}

const enemies = new Map();
const spawnListeners = new Set();
const defeatListeners = new Set();
const damageListeners = new Set();
let killCount = 0;

export const enemyTestConfig = { oneHp: isAdminSeed };
const savedEnemyHealth = new WeakMap();

/** Toggle 1-HP enemies for this session, including elites, bosses and future spawns. */
export function setOneHpEnemies(enabled) {
  enemyTestConfig.oneHp = Boolean(enabled);
  for (const enemy of enemies.values()) applyEnemyHealthTest(enemy);
}

/** Preserve normal health so disabling the test restores surviving enemies. */
function applyEnemyHealthTest(enemy) {
  if (enemyTestConfig.oneHp) {
    if (!savedEnemyHealth.has(enemy)) savedEnemyHealth.set(enemy, { hp: enemy.hp, maxHp: enemy.maxHp });
    enemy.hp = enemy.maxHp = 1;
  } else if (savedEnemyHealth.has(enemy)) {
    Object.assign(enemy, savedEnemyHealth.get(enemy));
    savedEnemyHealth.delete(enemy);
  }

import {getEnemyHurtbox} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
export const frozenSettings={duration:3,opacity:.55,coverageScale:1.5,source:'../sprites/icons/effects/frozen.png'};
let ice;
export const frozenReady=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{ice=new Image();ice.onload=resolve;ice.onerror=reject;ice.src=frozenSettings.source;});
export function applyFrozen(enemy,seconds=frozenSettings.duration){
  if(!(seconds>0)||enemy.hp===0)return false;
  enemy.frozenRemaining=Math.max(enemy.frozenRemaining||0,seconds);enemy.moving=false;return true;
}
export function freezeVisibleEnemies(enemies,camera,width,height){
  let count=0;for(const enemy of enemies){const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
    if(body.x+body.rx<camera.x||body.x-body.rx>camera.x+width||body.y+body.ry<camera.y||body.y-body.ry>camera.y+height)continue;
    if(applyFrozen(enemy))count++;
  }return count;
}
export function drawFrozenStatus(context,camera,enemy){
  if(!(enemy.frozenRemaining>0)||enemy.hp===0||!ice?.naturalWidth)return;
  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),height=Math.max(body.ry*2,enemy.spriteSize||0)*frozenSettings.coverageScale,
    width=Math.max(body.rx*2*frozenSettings.coverageScale,height*ice.naturalWidth/ice.naturalHeight);
  context.save();context.globalAlpha=frozenSettings.opacity;
  context.drawImage(ice,body.x-camera.x-width/2,body.y-camera.y-height/2,width,height);context.restore();
}

}

/** Put tall map objects in front of actors walking behind their solid bases. */
function drawCharacterOcclusion(character) {
  if (enemyRenderLayer(character) !== 'normal') return; // Specials and bosses appear above map foregrounds.
  const opacity = character === characters[selected] ? obstacleVisibility.playerOpacity : 1;
  if (currentMap === 'first') drawOfficeMonumentOcclusion(context, character, maps.first, camera, canvas.height, opacity);
  if (currentMap === 'fourth') drawTowerOcclusion(context, character, maps.fourth, camera, opacity);
  if (currentMap === 'second') drawPalaceOcclusion(context, character, maps.second, camera, canvas.width, opacity);
}

/** Draw animation poses with a short blend when entering/leaving boss actions. */
function drawCharacter(character) {
  if (character.death && character.lastPose && !character.animationFrames) {
    drawPose(character, character.lastPose, 1);
    drawCharacterOcclusion(character);
    return;
  }
  if (character.animationFrames) {
    const frames=character.actionAnimations?.[character.bossAction?.clip] || character.animationFrames;
    const frame = frames[gifFrameAt(frames, character.frozenPoseElapsed ?? (character.bossAction?.clip ? (character.bossAction.elapsed||0)*1000 : character.gifElapsed || 0))];
    const image = frame.image;
    const animatedCharacter={...character,image};
    const anchor=character.gifPoseAnchors?.[character.bossAction?.clip||'normal'];
    drawPose(animatedCharacter, {
      crop: { x: 0, y: 0, width: image.naturalWidth, height: image.naturalHeight, footY: anchor?.footY??image.naturalHeight,anchorX:anchor?.anchorX },
      mirrored: character.facing !== (character.nativeFacing || 'left')
    }, 1);
    character.spriteHurtbox=animatedCharacter.spriteHurtbox;
    drawCharacterOcclusion(character);
    return;
  }
  const pose = {
    crop: getFrameRectangle(character, getAnimationFrame(character)),
    mirrored: character.mirroredDirections?.includes(character.direction)
  };

/** Damage-receiving sprite bounds are separate from the small contact-damage ellipse. */
export function getEnemyHurtbox(character) {
  const size=character.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize;
  const bounds=character.spriteHurtbox||{offsetX:0,offsetY:0,width:size-spriteDisplayPadding*2,height:size-spriteDisplayPadding*2};
  const oval=bounds.mask?.ellipse;
  if(oval)return {x:character.x+bounds.offsetX+(oval.x-.5)*bounds.width*(bounds.mirrored?-1:1),
    y:character.y+bounds.offsetY+(oval.y-.5)*bounds.height,
    rx:oval.rx*bounds.width,ry:oval.ry*bounds.height,shape:'ellipse',
    coverage:oval.coverage,emptyFraction:oval.emptyFraction,meetsTargets:oval.meetsTargets};
  return {x:character.x+bounds.offsetX,y:character.y+bounds.offsetY,
    rx:Math.max(1,bounds.width/2),ry:Math.max(1,bounds.height/2),shape:'rectangle',
    mask:bounds.mask,mirrored:bounds.mirrored,maskWidth:bounds.width,maskHeight:bounds.height};
}

export function updateNpcContact(npc, player, motion, delta, move, survivalSeconds = 0) {
  if(npc.frozenRemaining>0)return false;
  npc.contactCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.contactCooldown || 0) - delta);
  // Per-enemy attack cooldown is separate from recoil and the player's global I-frames.
  npc.playerHitCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.playerHitCooldown || 0) - delta);
  const hit = contactGeometry(npc, player, motion);
  if (hit.touching && !(player.contactIFrames > 0) && !(npc.playerHitCooldown > 0)) {
    const baseDamage = npc.contactDamage ?? (npc.type === 'mob' ? contactSettings.mobDamage : contactSettings.playerDamage);
    const damage = npc.perTypeStats ? Math.floor(baseDamage * (npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1)) :
      enemyContactDamageFormula(baseDamage, player.level || 1, survivalSeconds, npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1);
    const damaged = damagePlayer(player, damage);
    if (damaged && npc.type === 'yuuka') npc.playerHitCooldown = yuukaSettings.contactHitInterval;
    if (damaged) player.contactIFrames = contactSettings.iFrameDuration;
  }
  const overrideBounce = npc.contactReaction?.kind === 'bounce' && hit.pushing;
  if (hit.touching && ((!npc.contactReaction && !npc.contactCooldown) || overrideBounce)) {
    const kind = hit.pushing ? 'push' : 'bounce';
    const settings = contactSettings[kind];
    const overlap = hit.overlap;
    const knockback = beginKnockback(npc, hit.nx * (settings.distance + overlap),
      hit.ny * (settings.distance + overlap), settings.travel);
    npc.contactReaction = knockback ? { ...knockback, kind, nx: hit.nx, ny: hit.ny } : null;
    if (!knockback) npc.contactCooldown = contactSettings.cooldown;
    npc.attack = null;
  }
  const reaction = npc.contactReaction;
  if (!reaction) return false;
  const settings = contactSettings[reaction.kind];
  advanceKnockback(npc, reaction, delta, move);
  const pauseChase = npc.contactRecoveryDelay !== false;
  if (pauseChase) npc.moving = false;
  const recovery = pauseChase ? settings.recovery : settings.travel;
  if (reaction.elapsed >= recovery) {
    npc.contactReaction = null;
    npc.contactCooldown = contactSettings.cooldown;
  }
  // Bosses still recoil/flash, but do not skip their AI update or wait afterward.
  return pauseChase;
}

import {tuningPerk,explosiveTuningSettings} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {getAllEnemies,damageEnemy} from './world-state.js';
import {getEnemyHurtbox} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import {drawArtilleryExplosion,artilleryExplosionDuration} from './artillery-explosion.js';
const triggered=new WeakSet(),effects=[];
/** One successful proc per attack/projectile; splash never re-enters this function. */
export function tryTuningExplosion({player,projectile,enemy,rollDamage,onHit=()=>{},random=Math.random,weaponId="plana-umbrella"}){
  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  if(weaponId!==main||!player.tuningParts||triggered.has(projectile))return false;
  const chance=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'explosionChance');if(!(chance>0)||random()>=chance)return false;
  triggered.add(projectile);
  const center=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),zone={x:center.x,y:center.y,radius:explosiveTuningSettings.radius,age:0};effects.push(zone);
  for(const target of getAllEnemies()){
    const body=getEnemyHurtbox(target);
    if(Math.hypot(body.x-zone.x,body.y-zone.y)>zone.radius+Math.max(body.rx,body.ry))continue;
    const hit=rollDamage(target,explosiveTuningSettings.damageMultiplier,{growthEligible:false});
    const landed=damageEnemy(target.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{tuningExplosion:true});
    // Accepted splash goes through normal damage/on-hit listeners (including future Greed).
    if(landed)onHit(landed);
  }
  return true;
}
export function updateTuningExplosions(delta){for(let i=effects.length-1;i>=0;i--){effects[i].age+=delta;if(effects[i].age>=artilleryExplosionDuration)effects.splice(i,1);}}
export function drawTuningExplosions(context,camera){for(const effect of effects)drawArtilleryExplosion(context,camera,effect,effect.age);}
export function clearTuningExplosions(){effects.length=0;}

import {tuningPartCatalog,tuningPartSettings} from './tuning-parts.js';
/** Manual test drops bypass random odds and run exclusions, without changing natural drops. */
export function createTuningAdmin({root,getPlayer,system}) {
  const type=root.querySelector('#admin-tuning-type'),level=root.querySelector('#admin-tuning-level');
  const button=root.querySelector('#admin-spawn-tuning'),status=root.querySelector('#admin-tuning-status');
  type.replaceChildren();
  for(const part of tuningPartCatalog){const option=document.createElement('option');option.value=part.id;option.textContent=part.name;type.append(option);}
  button.disabled=!tuningPartCatalog.length;
  button.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const part=tuningPartCatalog.find(part=>part.id===type.value),rank=Number(level.value);
    if(!part||!Number.isInteger(rank)||rank<1||rank>tuningPartSettings.maxLevel)return;
    const player=getPlayer(),drop=system.spawn(player.x+80,player.y,{id:part.id,level:rank});
    status.textContent=drop?`${part.name} LV ${rank} spawned near the player.`:'No safe ground available for this drop.';
  });
}

/** Roll per-hit critical chance; target debuffs add percentage points before clamping. */
export function rollAttackDamage(character, totalWeaponDamage, random = Math.random,
  { damageMod = 1, forceCritical = false, targetCritBonus = 0, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent = 0, target, weaponId } = {}) {
  const stats = ensureCombatStats(character);
  const buffs=Object.values(character.combatBuffs||{}).filter(Boolean);
  const bonusCrit=buffs.reduce((sum,buff)=>sum+(Number(buff.critPercent)||0),0);
  const critical = forceCritical || random() < Math.max(0, Math.min(100, stats.critPercent + bonusCrit + targetCritBonus)) / 100;
  const combinedModifier = damageModifiersFormula({
    criticalMultiplier: critical ? characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent + startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'critDamagePercent')) : 1,
    bonusDamageTaken: bonusDamageTakenFormula(target?.bonusDamageTakenPercent ?? []),
    DB: damageBonusFormula([...stats.damageBonusMultipliers,...buffs.map(buff=>buff.damageBonusMultiplier).filter(Number.isFinite)]),
    DR: damageReductionFormula(target?.damageReductionPercent ?? []),

/** Create one scattered report; explicit admin EXP overrides remain supported. */
function dropExpReport(enemy, random, value, tier = reportTier(value)) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return;
  const drop = {
    id: ++nextId, kind: 'exp', value, tier, x: enemy.x,
    y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
    rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2
  };
  drops.set(drop.id, drop);
  launchDrop(drop, random);
  return drop;
}

/** Spawn a specific ground pickup for repeatable admin testing. */
export function spawnTestDrop(kind, value, x, y) {
  if (!['exp', 'credits', 'secretTechNotes'].includes(kind)) return;
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 1) return;
  const drop = { id: ++nextId, kind, value: Math.floor(value),
    tier: reportTier(value), x, y, rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2 };
  drops.set(drop.id, drop);
  launchDrop(drop);
  return drop;
}

/** Apply one pickup's reward without coupling inventory to the controlled avatar. */
function collectDrop(drop, player) {
  drops.delete(drop.id);
  if (drop.kind === 'exp') addPlayerExp(player, drop.value);
  else lootTotals[drop.kind] += drop.value;
}

/** Burst Yuuka credits throughout a disk, with angular coverage in every direction. */
export function dropYuukaCredits(enemy, defeated = false, random = Math.random) {
  const count = defeated ? yuukaSettings.deathCredits : yuukaSettings.hitCredits;
  const radius = bossExpRewards.maxDistance * yuukaSettings.burstRadiusMultiplier;
  const angleOffset = random() * Math.PI * 2;
  const rewards = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
    const drop = { id: ++nextId, kind: 'credits', value: 1, x: enemy.x,
      y: enemy.y + (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding,
      rotation: random() * Math.PI * 2 };
    drops.set(drop.id, drop);
    launchDrop(drop, random);
    if (defeated) {
      const angle = angleOffset + (index + random()) / count * Math.PI * 2;
      // Square root distributes credits by area, throughout the whole radius.
      const distance = Math.sqrt(random()) * radius;
      drop.scatter.dx = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
      drop.scatter.dy = Math.sin(angle) * distance;
      constrainDropLanding(drop);
    }
    rewards.push(drop);
  }
  return rewards;
}

import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';

/** Stun independently of displacement, respecting knockback resistance and absolute immunity. */
export function applySkillControl(enemy, dx, dy, stunSeconds, travelSeconds, options = {}) {
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining || 0, stunSeconds);
  enemy.skillKnockback = beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, travelSeconds, options);
  enemy.contactReaction = null; enemy.attack = null; enemy.moving = false;
}

/** Resolve stun before AI/contact so a stunned enemy cannot move or damage the player. */
export function updateEnemyControl(enemy, delta, move) {
  if(enemy.frozenRemaining>0){
    enemy.frozenRemaining=Math.max(0,enemy.frozenRemaining-delta);
    if(enemy.frozenRemaining<1e-6)enemy.frozenRemaining=0;
    enemy.moving=false;return true; // Freeze also holds knockback and attack timers.
  }
  const stunned = enemy.stunRemaining > 0;
  if (!stunned && !enemy.skillKnockback) return false;
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(0, (enemy.stunRemaining || 0) - delta);
export function stopEnemyKnockback(enemy) {
  if (enemy.skillKnockback) enemy.skillKnockback.stopped = true;
  if (enemy.contactReaction) enemy.contactReaction.stopped = true;
}

/** Travel at constant effect speed until duration expires or the mover reports collision. */
export function advanceKnockback(enemy, motion, delta, move) {
  motion.elapsed += Math.max(0, delta);
  const progress = Math.min(1, motion.elapsed / motion.duration);
  const step = progress - motion.applied;
  if (!motion.stopped && step > 0 && move(enemy, motion.dx * step, motion.dy * step) === false) motion.stopped = true;
  motion.applied = progress;
  return !motion.stopped && progress < 1;
}

  const image = new Image(); image.src = new URL('../sprites/attacks/plana umbrella.png', import.meta.url).href;
  const ready = image.decode();
  let projectiles = [];
  return {
    ready,
    cast(player, angle, damageMultiplier = skillCastSettings.damageAverage, getLaunchAngle) {
      projectiles.push({ owner: player, angle, getLaunchAngle, x: player.x, y: player.y, elapsed: 0, tailElapsed: 0,
        damageMultiplier: Number.isFinite(damageMultiplier)
          ? Math.max(skillCastSettings.damageMinimum, Math.min(skillCastSettings.damageMaximum, damageMultiplier))
          : skillCastSettings.damageAverage,
        distance: 0, hits: new Set(), trail: [], baseDamage: umbrellaBaseDamage() });
    },
    reset() { projectiles = []; },
    update(delta) {
      const s = planaSkillSettings;
      for (const projectile of projectiles) {
        const previousTime = projectile.elapsed;
        const launchTime = s.openingSeconds + s.prelaunchSeconds;
        for (const point of projectile.trail) point.age += delta;
        projectile.trail = projectile.trail.filter(point => point.age < s.trailSeconds);
        if (projectile.distance >= s.maxDistance) {
          projectile.tailElapsed += delta;
          continue;
        }
    const landed=damageEnemy(target.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{tuningExplosion:true});
    // Accepted splash goes through normal damage/on-hit listeners (including future Greed).
    if(landed){if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'creditChancePercent')>0)tryLuxeryTuningHit({player,enemy:target,damage:hit.damage});onHit(landed);if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'coldDamagePercent')>0)tryColdTuningHit({player,enemy:landed,rollDamage:(target,multiplier)=>rollDamage(target,multiplier,{growthEligible:false})});}
  }
  return true;
}
export function updateTuningExplosions(delta){for(let i=effects.length-1;i>=0;i--){effects[i].age+=delta;if(effects[i].age>=artilleryExplosionDuration)effects.splice(i,1);}}
export function drawTuningExplosions(context,camera){for(const effect of effects)drawArtilleryExplosion(context,camera,effect,effect.age);}
export function clearTuningExplosions(){effects.length=0;}

/** Death protection allows zero HP; use this check when handling player defeat. */
export function isPlayerDefeated(character) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  return character.hp <= 0 && !character.invincible;
}

/** Add or remove shield points, capped by max HP without changing health. */
export function changePlayerShield(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (Number.isFinite(amount)) {
    character.shield = Math.max(0, Math.min(character.maxHp, character.shield + Math.trunc(amount)));
  }
}

/** Absorb damage with shield first; spill excess into HP and show one hit number. */
export function damagePlayer(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return false;
  const damage = Math.round(amount * damageReductionFormula(character.damageReductionPercent ?? []));
  const absorbed = Math.min(character.shield, damage);
  character.shield -= absorbed;
  const previous = character.hp;
  character.hp = Math.max(0, character.hp - (damage - absorbed));
  const taken = absorbed + previous - character.hp;
  if (taken > 0) {
    character.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
    showDamageNumber(character, taken, true);
  }
  return taken > 0;
}

/** Heal without exceeding maximum HP; works while invincible. */
export function healPlayer(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (Number.isFinite(amount) && amount > 0) {
    character.hp = Math.min(character.maxHp, character.hp + Math.floor(amount));
  }
}

export { defaultCombatStats } from './game-config.js';
// Percent bonuses: zero keeps base values. CRIT is a direct chance percentage.


/** Initialize independent per-character combat stats without resetting upgrades. */
export function ensureCombatStats(character) {
  character.combatStats ??= {};
  character.combatStats.damageBonusMultipliers ??= [];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(defaultCombatStats)) character.combatStats[key] ??= value;
  return character.combatStats;
}

/** Convert a bonus percentage to a multiplier (25% means 1.25 times base). */
export function statMultiplier(character, key) {
  const value = Number(ensureCombatStats(character)[key]);
  if (key === 'atkPercent') return totalCharacterATK(character) / 100;
  return percentBonusFormula(value);
}
