import {getEnemyHurtbox} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
export const frozenSettings={duration:3,opacity:.55,coverageScale:1.65,source:'../sprites/icons/effects/frozen.png'};
let ice;
export const frozenReady=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{ice=new Image();ice.onload=resolve;ice.onerror=reject;ice.src=frozenSettings.source;});
export function applyFrozen(enemy,seconds=frozenSettings.duration){
  if(!(seconds>0)||enemy.hp===0)return false;
  enemy.frozenRemaining=Math.max(enemy.frozenRemaining||0,seconds);enemy.moving=false;return true;
}
export function freezeVisibleEnemies(enemies,camera,width,height){
  let count=0;for(const enemy of enemies){const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
    if(body.x+body.rx<camera.x||body.x-body.rx>camera.x+width||body.y+body.ry<camera.y||body.y-body.ry>camera.y+height)continue;
    if(applyFrozen(enemy))count++;
  }return count;
}
export function drawFrozenStatus(context,camera,enemy){
  if(!(enemy.frozenRemaining>0)||enemy.hp===0||!ice?.naturalWidth)return;
  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),size=enemy.spriteSize||Math.max(body.rx,body.ry)*2,
    height=size*frozenSettings.coverageScale,
    width=Math.max(size*frozenSettings.coverageScale,height*ice.naturalWidth/ice.naturalHeight);
  context.save();context.globalAlpha=frozenSettings.opacity;
  context.drawImage(ice,enemy.x-camera.x-width/2,enemy.y-camera.y-height/2,width,height);context.restore();
}
export function createFrozenAdmin({root,getEnemies,getCamera,getSize}){
  const status=root.querySelector('[role="status"]');
  root.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click',()=>{const {width,height}=getSize();const count=freezeVisibleEnemies(getEnemies(),getCamera(),width,height);status.textContent=`Frozen ${count} onscreen enemies for 3 seconds.`;});
}

export function animateFrozenEnemy(enemy,player,delta){

  const directions=['up','upRight','right','downRight','down','downLeft','left','upLeft'];

  enemy.moving=true;enemy.elapsed=(enemy.elapsed||0)+delta*1000;
  if(enemy.attack)enemy.attack.elapsed=(enemy.attack.elapsed||0)+delta*1000;

/** Load predecoded GIF display frames while retaining original frame durations. */
export async function loadGifAnimation(character) {
  character.animationFrames = await Promise.all(character.gifFrames.map(frame =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const image = new Image();
      image.onload = () => resolve({ image, duration: frame.duration });
      image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${frame.source}.`));
      image.src = frame.source;
    })
  ));
  character.image = character.animationFrames[0].image;
}

/** Select the original GIF frame for elapsed playback time, including while idle. */
export function gifFrameAt(frames, elapsed) {
  const total = frames.reduce((sum, frame) => sum + frame.duration, 0);
  let time = elapsed % total;
  for (let i = 0; i < frames.length; i++) {
    time -= frames[i].duration;
    if (time < 0) return i;
  }
  return 0;
}
import {getEnemyHurtbox} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
export const stunnedSettings={testSeconds:3,source:'../sprites/icons/effects/stunned.png',headGap:2,headInset:.35};
let stars;
export const stunnedReady=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{stars=new Image();stars.onload=resolve;stars.onerror=reject;stars.src=stunnedSettings.source;});
export function applyStunned(enemy,seconds=stunnedSettings.testSeconds){
  if(!(seconds>0)||enemy.hp===0)return false;
  enemy.stunRemaining=Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining||0,seconds);enemy.moving=false;return true;
}
export function stunVisibleEnemies(enemies,camera,width,height){
  let count=0;for(const enemy of enemies){const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
    if(body.x+body.rx<camera.x||body.x-body.rx>camera.x+width||body.y+body.ry<camera.y||body.y-body.ry>camera.y+height)continue;
    if(applyStunned(enemy))count++;
  }return count;
}
export function drawStunnedStatus(context,camera,enemy){
  if(!(enemy.stunRemaining>0)||enemy.hp===0||!stars?.naturalWidth)return;
  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),width=Math.max(32,Math.min(140,body.rx*1.6)),height=width*stars.naturalHeight/stars.naturalWidth;
  context.save();context.drawImage(stars,body.x-camera.x-width/2,body.y-camera.y-body.ry+body.ry*2*stunnedSettings.headInset-stunnedSettings.headGap-height,width,height);context.restore();
}
export function createStunnedAdmin({root,getEnemies,getCamera,getSize}){
  const status=root.querySelector('[role="status"]');
  root.querySelector('#admin-stun-visible').addEventListener('click',()=>{const {width,height}=getSize();const count=stunVisibleEnemies(getEnemies(),getCamera(),width,height);status.textContent=`Stunned ${count} onscreen enemies for 3 seconds.`;});
}

export function totalWeaponDamage(character, weaponId, base, bonusesPercent = [], options = {}) {
  const mainWeaponId = character.mainWeaponId ?? (character.label === 'Plana' ? 'plana-umbrella' : null);
  const weapon=character.attackSlots?.find(item=>item?.id===weaponId);
  return weaponDamageFormula(base, [...bonusesPercent,startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'damagePercent'),-startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'weaponDamagePenaltyPercent')], {
    ...options, enhancementRank:weapon?.enhancementRank ?? 0, growthEligible: weaponId === mainWeaponId,
    growthRank: options.growthEligible===false?0:(character.growthRank ?? growthSettings.defaultRank), playerLevel: character.level ?? 1
  });
}

  const hitTimes = new Map();

  /** Cancel attacks on avatar/loadout changes and start one sweep per configured attack interval. */
  function update(delta, player, aim, eraseProjectiles) {
    if (!autoattackEnabled) return;
    const equipped = player.attackSlots?.some(item => item?.id === 'plana-umbrella');
    if (!equipped) { owner = null; swing = null; cycle = 0; clock = 0; hitTimes.clear(); return; }
    if (owner !== player) { owner = player; swing = null; cycle = 0; clock = 0; hitTimes.clear(); }
    clock += delta;
    for (const [id, time] of hitTimes) if (clock-time > umbrellaSettings.interval+umbrellaSettings.hitCooldown) hitTimes.delete(id);
    cycle = Math.max(0, cycle - delta);
    if (!swing && cycle <= 0) {

          : skillCastSettings.damageAverage,
        distance: 0, hits: new Set(), trail: [], baseDamage: umbrellaBaseDamage() });
    },
    reset() { projectiles = []; },
    update(delta,eraseProjectiles) {
      const s = planaSkillSettings;
      for (const projectile of projectiles) {
        const tunedKnockbackDistance=s.knockbackDistance*(projectile.owner.tuningParts?knockbackTuningMultiplier(projectile.owner):1);
        const previousTime = projectile.elapsed;
        const launchTime = s.openingSeconds + s.prelaunchSeconds;
        for (const point of projectile.trail) point.age += delta;
        projectile.trail = projectile.trail.filter(point => point.age < s.trailSeconds);
        if (projectile.distance >= s.maxDistance) {
          projectile.tailElapsed += delta;
          continue;
        }
        projectile.elapsed += delta;
        // Follow the arrow only during fade-in; the open-pose hold and flight use the locked angle.
        if (previousTime < s.openingSeconds && projectile.getLaunchAngle) {
          const aim = projectile.getLaunchAngle();
          if (Number.isFinite(aim)) projectile.angle = aim;
        }
        const ux = Math.cos(projectile.angle), uy = Math.sin(projectile.angle);
        if (previousTime < launchTime) {
          projectile.x = projectile.owner.x + ux * umbrellaSettings.baseRadius;
          projectile.y = projectile.owner.y + uy * umbrellaSettings.baseRadius;
        }
        const flightTime = Math.max(0, projectile.elapsed - Math.max(previousTime, launchTime));
        if (!flightTime) continue;
        const from = { x: projectile.x, y: projectile.y };
        const step = Math.min(s.maxDistance - projectile.distance, s.projectileSpeed * flightTime);
        projectile.x += ux * step; projectile.y += uy * step; projectile.distance += step;

/** Parts affect only the explicitly identified character starting weapon. */
export function startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,key) {
  const main=character.mainWeaponId??(character.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  return main&&weaponId===main&&character.tuningParts?tuningPerk(character.tuningParts,key):0;
}

      function drawPose(projectile, point, index, opacity, blur = 0, scale = 1) {
        const [x, y, width, height] = umbrellaOpeningFrames[index];
        const length = s.displayLength * scale;
        context.save();
        context.globalAlpha = opacity;
        context.filter = blur ? `blur(${blur}px)` : 'none';
        context.translate(point.x - camera.x, point.y - camera.y);
        context.rotate(projectile.angle + Math.PI / 2);
        context.drawImage(image, x, y, width, height,
          -length * width / height / 2, -length / 2, length * width / height, length);
        context.restore();
      }
      for (const projectile of projectiles) {
        const launchTime = s.openingSeconds + s.prelaunchSeconds;
        if (projectile.elapsed < launchTime) {
          // Fade up as the sheet opens, then hold the open pose briefly before release.
          const progress = Math.min(1, projectile.elapsed / s.openingSeconds);
          const eased = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress);
          drawPose(projectile, projectile, Math.min(7, Math.floor(progress * 8)),
            eased, 0, .85 + .15 * eased);
          continue;
        }
        for (const point of projectile.trail) {
          const life = Math.max(0, 1 - point.age / s.trailSeconds);
          drawPose(projectile, point, 7, .085 * life * life, s.trailBlur);
        }
        // A soft continuous streak connects the sampled silhouettes into one swift blur.
        if (projectile.trail.length > 1) {
          context.save();
          context.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - projectile.tailElapsed / s.trailSeconds);
          context.filter = `blur(${s.trailBlur}px)`;
          const first = projectile.trail[0];
          const gradient = context.createLinearGradient(first.x-camera.x, first.y-camera.y,
            projectile.x-camera.x, projectile.y-camera.y);
          gradient.addColorStop(0, '#70dfff00');
          gradient.addColorStop(1, '#b9f4ff66');
          context.strokeStyle = gradient;
          context.lineWidth = s.displayLength * .26;
          context.lineCap = 'round';
          context.beginPath();
          context.moveTo(first.x-camera.x, first.y-camera.y);
          context.lineTo(projectile.x-camera.x, projectile.y-camera.y);
          context.stroke();
          context.restore();
        }
        const headOpacity = Math.max(0, 1 - projectile.tailElapsed / .08);
        drawPose(projectile, projectile, 7, headOpacity);
      }
    }
  };

    /** Remove automatic volleys only; an active EX continues updating and dealing damage. */
    setAutoattackEnabled(enabled) { autoattackEnabled=Boolean(enabled); if(!autoattackEnabled) volleys=[]; },
    /** Start a continuous, independently aimable EX; shared per-target cooldown prevents frame damage. */
    cast(player, angle, damageMultiplier = 1.5, getAngle = () => angle) {
      if (owner !== player) { clear(); owner = player; }
      volleys = []; // Cancel the current automatic beam before the EX opening.
      special = { player, angle, getAngle, damageMultiplier, elapsed: 0, hits: new Map() };
    },
    update(delta, player, aim) {
      if (!getWeapon(player)) { clear(); return; }
      if (owner !== player) { clear(); owner = player; }
      clock += delta;
      if (special) {
        special.elapsed += delta;
        special.angle = special.getAngle();
        if (supernovaBeamPhase(special.elapsed).finished || special.player !== player) special = null;
      }
      for (const [id, time] of hitTimes) if (clock-time > s.hitCooldown+s.beamSeconds) hitTimes.delete(id);
      if (autoattackEnabled && !special) cooldown = Math.max(0, cooldown - delta);
      if (autoattackEnabled && !special && cooldown <= 0) {
        const stats = arisLevelStats(player);
        volleys.push({ elapsed: 0, angles: stats.beams === 2 ? [aim, aim + Math.PI] : [aim],
          width: s.beamWidth * stats.size, origin: arisBeamAnchor(player) });
        cooldown = attackTimeFormula(stats.interval, ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);
      }
      const active = [...volleys];
      if (special && supernovaBeamPhase(special.elapsed).damaging) active.push({ elapsed: special.elapsed, angles: [special.angle], width: supernovaSkillSettings.beamWidth,
        origin: arisBeamAnchor(player), special: true });
      for (const volley of active) {
        const visualDuration = activeDuration * arisBeamVisualSettings.durationMultiplier;
        const collapse = Math.max(.06, visualDuration-activeDuration);
        const pulse = 1 + arisBeamVisualSettings.pulseDepth *
          Math.sin(volley.elapsed*Math.PI*2*arisBeamVisualSettings.pulsesPerSecond) ** 8;
        const thickness = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volley.elapsed/.025,
          (visualDuration-volley.elapsed)/collapse)) * pulse;
        for (const angle of volley.angles) {
          context.save();
          context.translate(volley.origin.x - camera.x, volley.origin.y - camera.y);
          context.rotate(angle);
          // Shift only the EX light cone toward the gun; the weapon emergence stays anchored.
          const offset = arisBeamOffset(volley.origin,angle,volley.special) +
            (volley.special ? supernovaSkillSettings.beamStartAdjustment : 0);
          const cone = arisBeamVisualSettings.coneLength;
          // Additive bloom spreads blue/cyan light around the beam without changing its hit area.
          const visual = arisBeamVisualSettings;
          const layers = [
            [visual.bloomSpread, `rgba(36,151,255,${visual.bloomOpacity})`, visual.bloomBlur, 'lighter'],

            [.55, '#f1ffff', 1.5, 'source-over']
          ];
          for (const [scale, color, blur, blend] of layers) {

            context.filter = `blur(${blur}px)`;
            context.fillStyle = color;

export function rainbowTrailGradient(context,x1,y1,x2,y2){

  ['#ff6090','#ffad57','#fff178','#73f7a7','#66e5ff','#9292ff','#ec80ff'].forEach((color,i)=>gradient.addColorStop(i/6,color));

/** Cumulative weapon-level bonuses; awakening is a separate state after level seven. */
export function umbrellaLevelStats(player) {
  const level = Math.max(1, Math.min(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel, getUmbrella(player)?.level || 1));
  const damageTiers = Number(level >= 2) + Number(level >= 5);
  const areaTiers = Number(level >= 3) + Number(level >= 6);
  return {
    level, damageMultiplier: (1 + umbrellaUpgradeSettings.damageIncrease) ** damageTiers,
    areaScale: Math.sqrt(1 + areaTiers * umbrellaUpgradeSettings.areaIncrease),
    intervalMultiplier: (level >= 4 ? umbrellaUpgradeSettings.intervalMultiplier : 1) *
      (1-(player.tuningParts?startingWeaponTuning(player,'plana-umbrella','attackTimeReductionPercent'):0)/100),
    guaranteedCritical: level >= 7,
    awakened: Boolean(getUmbrella(player)?.awakened)
  };
}

 * mainWeaponId can explicitly identify a character main weapon; Plana defaults to her umbrella.

export function totalWeaponDamage(character, weaponId, base, bonusesPercent = [], options = {}) {
  const mainWeaponId = character.mainWeaponId ?? (character.label === 'Plana' ? 'plana-umbrella' : null);
  const weapon=character.attackSlots?.find(item=>item?.id===weaponId);
  return weaponDamageFormula(base, [...bonusesPercent,startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'damagePercent'),-startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'weaponDamagePenaltyPercent')], {

    growthRank: options.growthEligible===false?0:(character.growthRank ?? growthSettings.defaultRank), playerLevel: character.level ?? 1
  });
}

import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
export const trumpetTuningSettings={source:'../Audio/SFX/why.mp3'};
const lastDoot=new WeakMap(),voices=new Set();let clock=0;
export function updateTrumpetTuning(delta){clock+=Math.max(0,delta);}
/** Independent voices overlap and finish naturally; no pause/reset/restart on another shot. */
export function playTrumpetTuning(player,weaponId='plana-umbrella'){
  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null),run=player.tuningParts;
  if(weaponId!==main||!run||typeof Audio==='undefined')return false;
  const frames=tuningPerk(run,'dootCooldownFrames');if(!frames||clock-(lastDoot.get(run)??-Infinity)<frames/60-1e-8)return false;
  lastDoot.set(run,clock);
  const voice=new Audio(trumpetTuningSettings.source);voice.loop=false;voice.volume=tuningPerk(run,'dootVolume');voices.add(voice);
  const finished=()=>voices.delete(voice);voice.addEventListener('ended',finished,{once:true});voice.addEventListener('error',finished,{once:true});
  try{const playing=voice.play();playing?.catch(finished);}catch{finished();}
  return true;
}

import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
export const trumpetTuningSettings={source:'../Audio/SFX/why.mp3'};
const lastDoot=new WeakMap(),voices=new Set(),voiceGains=new WeakMap(),boundSliders=new WeakSet();let clock=0,volume=1;
export function updateTrumpetTuning(delta){clock+=Math.max(0,delta);}
/** Independent voices overlap and finish naturally; no pause/reset/restart on another shot. */
export function playTrumpetTuning(player,weaponId='plana-umbrella'){
  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null),run=player.tuningParts;
  if(weaponId!==main||!run||typeof Audio==='undefined')return false;
  const frames=tuningPerk(run,'dootCooldownFrames');if(!frames||clock-(lastDoot.get(run)??-Infinity)<frames/60-1e-8)return false;
  lastDoot.set(run,clock);
  const voice=new Audio(trumpetTuningSettings.source);voice.loop=false;voiceGains.set(voice,tuningPerk(run,'dootVolume'));voice.volume=voiceGains.get(voice)*volume;voices.add(voice);
  const finished=()=>voices.delete(voice);voice.addEventListener('ended',finished,{once:true});voice.addEventListener('error',finished,{once:true});
  try{const playing=voice.play();playing?.catch(finished);}catch{finished();}
  return true;
}
export function trumpetVoiceCount(){return voices.size;}

/** Match the existing volume control, including voices already ringing out. */
export function setTrumpetVolume(value){
  volume=Number.isFinite(value)?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,value)):0;
  for(const voice of voices)voice.volume=voiceGains.get(voice)*volume;
}
export function bindTrumpetVolume(slider){
  if(!slider||boundSliders.has(slider))return;
  boundSliders.add(slider);const sync=()=>setTrumpetVolume(Number(slider.value)/100);
  slider.addEventListener('input',sync);sync();
}

/** Single bonus hit; does not recursively trigger itself or repeatedly tick. */
export function trySlowdownTuningHit({player,enemy,rollDamage,random=Math.random}){
  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  if(main!=='plana-umbrella'||!player.tuningParts||enemy.hp<=0)return false;

}

## My request:
**Super Synnergies&#x20;**&#x61;re powerful late-game weapons created through the fusion of a Synnergy weapon and a (max level) item. In order to create a Super Synnergy, the player must acquire a unique drop item known as a **Golden Hammer**, which only appears when the player has the necessary Synnergy and Item and is either at least Level 50 or has at least 3 Synnergyies. Once all of the requirements are met, a Super Synnergy can then be crafted at a Golden Crafter.



Only one Super Synnergy can be crafted per run.



## Mechanics

Certain conditions must be met for a Golden Hammer to appear:

1. The necessary Synnergy weapon must be present.
2. Player must either be at least Level 50 **or** have at least 3 Collabs total.

If the player has the necessary Synnergy weapon present, a golden half-shaft will appear on the upper right corner of the screen, indicating that the player is on the path to creating a Super Collab. If the player acquires a second Synnergy weapon, the half-shaft will become a longer full shaft, and if the player acquires three collabs before reaching level 50, the incomplete shaft will immediately become a Golden Hammer. Alternatively, upon reaching level 50 a complete Golden Hammer will appear on the ground that can be picked up.

Whichever method the player acquired it, possessing a Golden Hammer will allow the player to combine a valid Synnergy weapon and its accompanying Item, which must be either at max level or a Super Item. As with Synnergies, a Golden Crafter will appear on the field if players have all the necessary prerequisites for building a Super Synnergy.

Creating a Super Synnergy will remove the Item used to create it, freeing up an Item Slot. Only one Golden Hammer can be acquired in a run, limiting players to one Super Synnergy per run.\

import { synergyRecipes } from './synergy-recipes.js';
import { umbrellaUpgradeSettings, arisWeaponSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Use each weapon's actual MAX level, including future weapon definitions. */
function maximumLevel(weapon) {
  return weapon.id==='plana-umbrella'?umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel:
    weapon.id==='aris-laser'?arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel:weapon.maxLevel;
}

/** Only compatible, equipped MAX pairs can cause a Golden Crafter drop or fusion choice. */
export function goldenCrafterChoices(player,recipes=synergyRecipes) {
  const slots=player.attackSlots||[],choices=[];
  for(const recipe of recipes) {
    if(!recipe.id||!recipe.result?.id||recipe.ingredients?.length!==2||slots.some(w=>w?.id===recipe.result.id))continue;
    for(let a=0;a<Math.min(6,slots.length);a++)for(let b=a+1;b<Math.min(6,slots.length);b++) {
      const first=slots[a],second=slots[b];if(!first||!second)continue;
      const ids=[first.id,second.id].sort(),needed=[...recipe.ingredients].sort();
      if(ids[0]!==needed[0]||ids[1]!==needed[1])continue;
      if(!Number.isFinite(maximumLevel(first))||!Number.isFinite(maximumLevel(second))||
        (first.level||1)<maximumLevel(first)||(second.level||1)<maximumLevel(second))continue;
      choices.push({id:`synergy:${recipe.id}:${a}:${b}`,name:recipe.result.name||recipe.result.id,
        label:'Fuse MAX weapons',kind:'synergy',target:recipe.result,recipe,slots:[a,b],disabled:false,
        description:recipe.description||`Fuse ${first.name||first.id} and ${second.name||second.id} into ${recipe.result.name||recipe.result.id}.`});
    }
  }
  return choices;
}

/** Replace the two ingredients with one synergy atomically; cancellation never calls this. */

const luminousDescriptions={

/** Offer acquisition or the next Aris upgrade, plus existing umbrella choices. */
export function rollLevelUpgrades(player) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  const choices = umbrellaChoices(player);
  // Fusion ingredients stay out of the upgrade pool while their synergy is equipped.
  const blocked=new Set((player.attackSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).flatMap(item=>
    item.consumedWeaponIds||(item.id==='princess-key'?['aris-laser','luminous-nova']:[])));
  const weapon = getArisWeapon(player);
  if (!blocked.has('aris-laser') && !weapon && (player.attackSlots || []).filter(Boolean).length < 6) choices.push({
    id: 'aris-new', name: "Supernova LV 1", weapon: createArisWeapon(), category: 'NEW Weapon',
    description: 'Shoot a powerful piercing laser beam every 3 seconds.'
  });
  else if (!blocked.has('aris-laser') && weapon && (weapon.level || 1) < arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel) choices.push({
    id: 'aris-level', name: `Supernova ${upgradeLevelLabel(weapon,arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel)}`, weapon, category: 'Weapon',
    description: arisDescriptions[(weapon.level || 1) + 1]
  });
  const luminous=getLuminousNova(player);
  if(!blocked.has('luminous-nova')&&!luminous&&(player.attackSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).length<6)choices.push({
    id:'luminous-new',name:'Luminous Nova LV 1',weapon:createLuminousNovaWeapon(),category:'NEW Weapon',
    description:'Fire a fast, piercing pink plasma round at a random target.'});
  else if(!blocked.has('luminous-nova')&&luminous&&(luminous.level||1)<luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel)choices.push({
    id:'luminous-level',name:`Luminous Nova ${upgradeLevelLabel(luminous,luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel)}`,weapon:luminous,category:'Weapon',
    description:luminousDescriptions[(luminous.level||1)+1]});
  // Synergies improve only through Crafter enhancements, never level-up choices.
  return choices.filter(choice=>!choice.weapon?.isSynergy).slice(0, levelUpgradeSettings.choices);
}

/** Advance one weapon level; awakening is available only through a Crafter. */
export function applyLevelUpgrade(player, id) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  if (player.pendingUpgrades <= 0 || !rollLevelUpgrades(player).some(choice => choice.id === id)) return false;
  const weapon = id.startsWith('luminous-')?getLuminousNova(player):id.startsWith('aris-') ? getArisWeapon(player) : getUmbrella(player);
  if (id === 'aris-new'||id==='luminous-new') {
    player.attackSlots ??= [];
    const empty = player.attackSlots.findIndex(item => !item);
    const acquired=id==='luminous-new'?createLuminousNovaWeapon():createArisWeapon();
    if (empty >= 0) player.attackSlots[empty] = acquired;
    else player.attackSlots.push(acquired);
  } else if (id === 'aris-level') weapon.level = Math.min(arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else if(id==='luminous-level')weapon.level=Math.min(luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel,(weapon.level||1)+1);
  else if (id === 'umbrella-level') weapon.level = Math.min(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else return false;
  recordWeaponMax(player,weapon);
  player.pendingUpgrades--;
  return true;
}
import { crafterSettings, crafterEnhancementCost, crafterEnhancementChance, umbrellaUpgradeSettings, arisWeaponSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getLootTotals, spendCredits, spendSecretTechNotes } from './exp-drops.js';
import { recordWeaponMax } from './weapon-max-order.js';

/** List only equipped targets, keeping item upgrades capped and awakening main-weapon-only. */
export function crafterChoices(player) {
  const choices=[],loot=getLootTotals();
  for(const [kind,slots] of [['weapon',player.attackSlots||[]],['item',player.equipmentSlots||[]]]) {
    slots.forEach((target,index)=>{
      if(!target)return;
      const max=target.id==='plana-umbrella'?umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel:
        target.id==='aris-laser'?arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel:target.maxLevel;
      if(!Number.isFinite(max))return;
      const prefix=`${kind}:${index}`,name=target.name||target.id||'Item',level=target.level||1;
      if(!target.isSynergy&&level<max)choices.push({id:`${prefix}:level`,target,kind,name,label:`Upgrade to LV ${level+1}`,cost:0,disabled:false});
      else if(kind==='weapon') {
        const rank=(target.enhancementRank||0)+1,cost=crafterEnhancementCost(rank);
        const chance=crafterEnhancementChance(rank,player.enhancementRateBonusPercent||0);
        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:enhance`,target,kind,name,label:`Enhance +${rank} — ${cost} Credits — ${Math.round(chance*100)}% success`,cost,chance,rank,disabled:loot.credits<cost});
      }
      const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
      if(kind==='weapon'&&target.id==='plana-umbrella'&&main===target.id&&level>=max&&!target.awakened) {
        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:awaken`,target,kind,name,label:`Awaken — ${umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost} Secret Tech Note`,disabled:loot.secretTechNotes<umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost});
      }
    });
  }
  return choices;
}

/** A valid attempt consumes one Crafter even when a paid enhancement fails. */
export function applyCrafterChoice(player,id,random=Math.random) {
  const choice=crafterChoices(player).find(c=>c.id===id);
  if(!choice||choice.disabled)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'That upgrade is unavailable.'};
  const action=id.split(':').at(-1),target=choice.target;
  if(action==='level') {target.level=(target.level||1)+1;if(choice.kind==='weapon')recordWeaponMax(player,target);return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${choice.name} upgraded to LV ${target.level}.`};}
  if(action==='awaken') {
    if(!spendSecretTechNotes(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost))return {consumed:false,success:false};
    target.awakened=true;return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${choice.name} awakened!`};
  }
  if(!spendCredits(choice.cost))return {consumed:false,success:false};
  const success=random()<choice.chance;
  if(success)target.enhancementRank=choice.rank;
  return {consumed:true,success,message:success?`${choice.name} enhanced to +${choice.rank}!`:`Enhancement failed. ${choice.cost} Credits and the Crafter were consumed.`};
}

import { rollLevelUpgrades } from './level-upgrades.js';
import { recordWeaponMax } from './weapon-max-order.js';

// Add actual super items here when their effects are defined. Empty pools fall back to normal Files.
export const superFileItems=[];
export const fileSettings={superChance:.05,tripleChance:.09,newChance:.1,weaponChance:.7,
  dropChance:0,bossGuaranteed:true,icon:'../sprites/icons/3 Stars Character Icon.png',maxGround:20,
  creditReplacementPerMax:.05,creditReplacementCap:.6};

/** Inclusive integer rolls and the supplied nested-floor Credits formula. */
export function fileCredits(type,random=Math.random,moneyUpBonus=0,stageMultiplier=1) {
  const [a,b]=type==='super'?[399,5]:type==='triple'?[399,3]:[301,1];
  const integer=max=>Math.min(max,Math.floor(random()*(max+1)));
  const multiplier=(1+moneyUpBonus/100)*stageMultiplier;
  return Math.floor(Math.floor(a/(3+integer(2)))*multiplier*(1+b*(20+integer(10))/100*multiplier));
}

/** Apply one accepted product without spending level-up choices; dropping never applies it. */
export function acceptFileProduct(player,product) {
  const slots=product.kind==='item'?(player.equipmentSlots??=[]):(player.attackSlots??=[]);
  const owned=slots.find(item=>item?.id===product.weapon.id);
  if(owned) {
    if(owned.isSynergy)return false;
    const max=owned.maxLevel||7;if((owned.level||1)>=max)return false;
    owned.level=(owned.level||1)+1;if(product.kind!=='item')recordWeaponMax(player,owned);return true;
  }
  const index=slots.findIndex(item=>!item);
  if(index<0&&slots.filter(Boolean).length>=6)return false;
  const item={...product.weapon};if(index>=0)slots[index]=item;else slots.push(item);return true;
}

/** Generate products using a shadow inventory so triple rewards cannot overfill or overlevel it. */
export function rollFileRewards(player,{random=Math.random,forceType,getOptions=rollLevelUpgrades,superItems=superFileItems}={}) {
  const roll=random();let type=forceType||(roll<fileSettings.superChance?'super':roll<fileSettings.superChance+fileSettings.tripleChance?'triple':'normal');
  const supers=superItems.filter(item=>!player.equipmentSlots?.some(owned=>owned?.id===item.id)&&
    (player.equipmentSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).length<6);
  if(type==='super'&&!supers.length)type='normal';
  const result={type,products:[],credits:fileCredits(type,random,player.moneyUpBonus||0,player.stageCoinMultiplier??1)};
  if(type==='super') {
    const item=supers[Math.min(supers.length-1,Math.floor(random()*supers.length))];
    result.products.push({kind:'item',weapon:{...item,level:1},name:item.name,super:true});return result;
  }
  const shadow={...player,attackSlots:(player.attackSlots||[]).map(w=>w?{...w}:null),equipmentSlots:(player.equipmentSlots||[]).map(w=>w?{...w}:null)};
  const free={weapon:6-shadow.attackSlots.filter(Boolean).length,item:6-shadow.equipmentSlots.filter(Boolean).length};
  for(let index=0;index<(type==='triple'?3:1);index++) {
    const maxed=[...shadow.attackSlots,...shadow.equipmentSlots].filter(w=>w&&(w.isSynergy||(w.level||1)>=(w.maxLevel||7))).length;
    // Editable saturation behavior: each MAX slot adds 5 percentage points toward the 100-Credit substitution.
    if(random()<Math.min(fileSettings.creditReplacementCap,maxed*fileSettings.creditReplacementPerMax)){result.credits+=100;continue;}
    const options=getOptions(shadow).filter(choice=>choice.weapon&&!choice.weapon.isSynergy);
    let selected=null;
    const allowNew=random()<fileSettings.newChance;
    for(let attempt=0;attempt<5&&!selected;attempt++) {
      let kind=random()<fileSettings.weaponChance?'weapon':'item';
      const pool=k=>options.filter(option=>{
        const category=/item|equipment/i.test(option.category||'')?'item':'weapon';
        const owned=(k==='item'?shadow.equipmentSlots:shadow.attackSlots).some(w=>w?.id===option.weapon.id);
        return category===k&&(owned||(allowNew&&free[k]>index));

import { getFirebaseAuth } from '../firebase-client.js';
import { isAdmin } from '../admin-access.js';
import { isGuestSession } from '../guest-session.js';

/** Reveal development content only after Firebase confirms the admin session. */
export async function requireAdmin() {
  const content = document.querySelector('#development-content');
  if (isGuestSession()) {
    content.hidden = true;
    window.location.replace('../project.html');
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const { auth, sdk } = await getFirebaseAuth();

    return await new Promise(resolve => {
      sdk.onAuthStateChanged(auth, user => {
        const allowed = isAdmin(user);
        content.hidden = !allowed;

        if (!allowed) {
          window.location.replace(user ? '../project.html' : '../index.html');
        }

        resolve(allowed);
      }, () => {
        content.hidden = true;
        window.location.replace('../index.html');
        resolve(false);
      });
    });
  } catch {
    content.hidden = true;
    window.location.replace('../index.html');
    return false;
  }
}
// This tab-scoped marker identifies guest navigation; it never stores game progress.
const guestSessionKey = 'schale.guestSession';

/** Check whether this tab entered through the confirmed guest option. */
export function isGuestSession() {
  try { return sessionStorage.getItem(guestSessionKey) === '1'; }
  catch { return false; }
}

/** Begin guest access without creating a Firebase account or saving upgrades. */
export function startGuestSession() {
  sessionStorage.setItem(guestSessionKey, '1');
}

/** Return to account mode after a successful sign-in or registration. */
export function endGuestSession() {
  try { sessionStorage.removeItem(guestSessionKey); }
  catch { /* Storage may be disabled; an absent guest marker is already account mode. */ }
}

/** MAX weapons use their own energy color; awakening remains a separate upgrade. */
export function enhancedWeaponGlow(weapon) {
  if(!weapon||!(weapon.level>=7))return '';
  return weapon.id==='luminous-nova'?'#ff71d5':weapon.id==='aris-laser'?'#65cfff':'';
}

/** Apply the glow to the icon silhouette, never the surrounding inventory box. */
export function applyEnhancedWeaponGlow(element,weapon) {
  const color=enhancedWeaponGlow(weapon);
  element.style.filter=color?`drop-shadow(0 0 2px ${color}) drop-shadow(0 0 5px ${color})`:'';
}

import { crafterSettings, crafterEnhancementCost, crafterEnhancementChance, umbrellaUpgradeSettings, arisWeaponSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getLootTotals, spendCredits, spendSecretTechNotes } from './exp-drops.js';
import { recordWeaponMax } from './weapon-max-order.js';

/** List only equipped targets, keeping item upgrades capped and awakening main-weapon-only. */
export function crafterChoices(player) {
  const choices=[],loot=getLootTotals();
  for(const [kind,slots] of [['weapon',player.attackSlots||[]],['item',player.equipmentSlots||[]]]) {
    slots.forEach((target,index)=>{
      if(!target)return;
      const max=target.id==='plana-umbrella'?umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel:
        target.id==='aris-laser'?arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel:target.maxLevel;
      if(!Number.isFinite(max))return;
      const prefix=`${kind}:${index}`,name=target.name||target.id||'Item',level=target.level||1;
      if(!target.isSynergy&&level<max)choices.push({id:`${prefix}:level`,target,kind,name,label:`Upgrade to LV ${level+1}`,cost:0,disabled:false});
      else if(kind==='weapon') {
        const rank=(target.enhancementRank||0)+1,cost=crafterEnhancementCost(rank);
        const chance=crafterEnhancementChance(rank,player.enhancementRateBonusPercent||0);
        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:enhance`,target,kind,name,label:`Enhance +${rank} â€” ${cost} Credits â€” ${Math.round(chance*100)}% success`,cost,chance,rank,disabled:loot.credits<cost});
      }
      const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
      if(kind==='weapon'&&target.id==='plana-umbrella'&&main===target.id&&level>=max&&!target.awakened) {
        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:awaken`,target,kind,name,label:`Awaken â€” ${umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost} Secret Tech Note`,disabled:loot.secretTechNotes<umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost});
      }
    });
  }
  return choices;
}

/** A valid attempt consumes one Crafter even when a paid enhancement fails. */
export function applyCrafterChoice(player,id,random=Math.random) {
  const choice=crafterChoices(player).find(c=>c.id===id);
  if(!choice||choice.disabled)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'That upgrade is unavailable.'};
  const action=id.split(':').at(-1),target=choice.target;
  if(action==='level') {target.level=(target.level||1)+1;if(choice.kind==='weapon')recordWeaponMax(player,target);return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${choice.name} upgraded to LV ${target.level}.`};}
  if(action==='awaken') {
    if(!spendSecretTechNotes(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost))return {consumed:false,success:false};
    target.awakened=true;return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${choice.name} awakened!`};
  }
  if(!spendCredits(choice.cost))return {consumed:false,success:false};
  const success=random()<choice.chance;
  if(success)target.enhancementRank=choice.rank;
  return {consumed:true,success,message:success?`${choice.name} enhanced to +${choice.rank}!`:`Enhancement failed. ${choice.cost} Credits and the Crafter were consumed.`};
}

import { createLuminousNovaWeapon, getLuminousNova } from './luminous-nova.js';
import { recordWeaponMax } from './weapon-max-order.js';
import { upgradeLevelLabel } from './upgrade-label.js';
import { luminousNovaSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { umbrellaUpgradeSettings, arisWeaponSettings, levelUpgradeSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { ensurePlayerStats } from './player-stats.js';
import { createArisWeapon, getArisWeapon } from './aris-weapon.js';
import { getUmbrella } from './weapon-progression.js';

const descriptions = {
  2: 'Increase damage by 30%.',
  3: 'Increase attack area by 20%.',
  4: 'Reduce time between attacks by 10%.',
  5: 'Increase damage by 30%.',
  6: 'Increase attack area by 20%.',
  7: 'Critical hits are guaranteed and deal 3x damage.'
};

/** Offer only the next upgrade for an equipped, implemented weapon. */
function umbrellaChoices(player) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  const weapon = getUmbrella(player);
  if (!weapon) return [];
  const level = weapon.level || 1;
  if (level < umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel) return [{ id: 'umbrella-level',
    name: `Plana's Umbrella ${upgradeLevelLabel(weapon,umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel)}`, weapon, category: 'Weapon', description: descriptions[level + 1] }];
  return [];
}

const arisDescriptions = {
  2: 'Increase beam size by 30%.',
  3: 'Reduce attack cooldown by 0.5 seconds.',
  4: 'Increase damage by 50%.',
  5: 'Reduce attack cooldown by 0.5 seconds.',
  6: 'Increase beam size by 50%.',
  7: 'Fire an additional beam from behind.'
};

const luminousDescriptions={
  2:'Increase damage by 20%.',3:'Fire twice per base attack cycle.',4:'Increase damage by 30%.',
  5:'Fire three times per base attack cycle.',6:'Add knockback on hit.',7:'Fire four times per base attack cycle.'
};

/** Offer acquisition or the next Aris upgrade, plus existing umbrella choices. */
export function rollLevelUpgrades(player) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  const choices = umbrellaChoices(player);
  // Fusion ingredients stay out of the upgrade pool while their synergy is equipped.
  const blocked=new Set((player.attackSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).flatMap(item=>
    item.consumedWeaponIds||(item.id==='princess-key'?['aris-laser','luminous-nova']:[])));
  const weapon = getArisWeapon(player);
  if (!blocked.has('aris-laser') && !weapon && (player.attackSlots || []).filter(Boolean).length < 6) choices.push({
    id: 'aris-new', name: "Supernova LV 1", weapon: createArisWeapon(), category: 'NEW Weapon',
    description: 'Shoot a powerful piercing laser beam every 3 seconds.'
  });
  else if (!blocked.has('aris-laser') && weapon && (weapon.level || 1) < arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel) choices.push({
    id: 'aris-level', name: `Supernova ${upgradeLevelLabel(weapon,arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel)}`, weapon, category: 'Weapon',
    description: arisDescriptions[(weapon.level || 1) + 1]
  });
  const luminous=getLuminousNova(player);
  if(!blocked.has('luminous-nova')&&!luminous&&(player.attackSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).length<6)choices.push({
    id:'luminous-new',name:'Luminous Nova LV 1',weapon:createLuminousNovaWeapon(),category:'NEW Weapon',
    description:'Fire a fast, piercing pink plasma round at a random target.'});
  else if(!blocked.has('luminous-nova')&&luminous&&(luminous.level||1)<luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel)choices.push({
    id:'luminous-level',name:`Luminous Nova ${upgradeLevelLabel(luminous,luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel)}`,weapon:luminous,category:'Weapon',
    description:luminousDescriptions[(luminous.level||1)+1]});
  // Synergies improve only through Crafter enhancements, never level-up choices.
  return choices.filter(choice=>!choice.weapon?.isSynergy).slice(0, levelUpgradeSettings.choices);
}

/** Advance one weapon level; awakening is available only through a Crafter. */
export function applyLevelUpgrade(player, id) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  if (player.pendingUpgrades <= 0 || !rollLevelUpgrades(player).some(choice => choice.id === id)) return false;
  const weapon = id.startsWith('luminous-')?getLuminousNova(player):id.startsWith('aris-') ? getArisWeapon(player) : getUmbrella(player);
  if (id === 'aris-new'||id==='luminous-new') {
    player.attackSlots ??= [];
    const empty = player.attackSlots.findIndex(item => !item);
    const acquired=id==='luminous-new'?createLuminousNovaWeapon():createArisWeapon();
    if (empty >= 0) player.attackSlots[empty] = acquired;
    else player.attackSlots.push(acquired);
  } else if (id === 'aris-level') weapon.level = Math.min(arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else if(id==='luminous-level')weapon.level=Math.min(luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel,(weapon.level||1)+1);
  else if (id === 'umbrella-level') weapon.level = Math.min(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else return false;
  recordWeaponMax(player,weapon);
  player.pendingUpgrades--;
  return true;
}

import { recordWeaponMax } from './weapon-max-order.js';

/** Inclusive integer rolls and the supplied nested-floor Credits formula. */
export function fileCredits(type,random=Math.random,moneyUpBonus=0,stageMultiplier=1) {
  const [a,b]=type==='super'?[399,5]:type==='triple'?[399,3]:[301,1];
  const integer=max=>Math.min(max,Math.floor(random()*(max+1)));
  const multiplier=(1+moneyUpBonus/100)*stageMultiplier;
  return Math.floor(Math.floor(a/(3+integer(2)))*multiplier*(1+b*(20+integer(10))/100*multiplier));
}

/** Apply one accepted product without spending level-up choices; dropping never applies it. */
export function acceptFileProduct(player,product) {
  const slots=product.kind==='item'?(player.equipmentSlots??=[]):(player.attackSlots??=[]);
  const owned=slots.find(item=>item?.id===product.weapon.id);
  if(owned) {
    if(owned.isSynergy)return false;
    const max=owned.maxLevel||7;if((owned.level||1)>=max)return false;
    owned.level=(owned.level||1)+1;if(product.kind!=='item')recordWeaponMax(player,owned);return true;
  }
  const index=slots.findIndex(item=>!item);
  if(index<0&&slots.filter(Boolean).length>=6)return false;
  const item={...product.weapon};if(index>=0)slots[index]=item;else slots.push(item);return true;
}

/** Generate products using a shadow inventory so triple rewards cannot overfill or overlevel it. */
export function rollFileRewards(player,{random=Math.random,forceType,getOptions=rollLevelUpgrades,superItems=superFileItems}={}) {
  const roll=random();let type=forceType||(roll<fileSettings.superChance?'super':roll<fileSettings.superChance+fileSettings.tripleChance?'triple':'normal');
  const supers=superItems.filter(item=>!player.equipmentSlots?.some(owned=>owned?.id===item.id)&&
    (player.equipmentSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).length<6);
  if(type==='super'&&!supers.length)type='normal';
  const result={type,products:[],credits:fileCredits(type,random,player.moneyUpBonus||0,player.stageCoinMultiplier??1)};
  if(type==='super') {
    const item=supers[Math.min(supers.length-1,Math.floor(random()*supers.length))];
    result.products.push({kind:'item',weapon:{...item,level:1},name:item.name,super:true});return result;
  }
  const shadow={...player,attackSlots:(player.attackSlots||[]).map(w=>w?{...w}:null),equipmentSlots:(player.equipmentSlots||[]).map(w=>w?{...w}:null)};
  const free={weapon:6-shadow.attackSlots.filter(Boolean).length,item:6-shadow.equipmentSlots.filter(Boolean).length};
  for(let index=0;index<(type==='triple'?3:1);index++) {
    const maxed=[...shadow.attackSlots,...shadow.equipmentSlots].filter(w=>w&&(w.isSynergy||(w.level||1)>=(w.maxLevel||7))).length;
    // Editable saturation behavior: each MAX slot adds 5 percentage points toward the 100-Credit substitution.
    if(random()<Math.min(fileSettings.creditReplacementCap,maxed*fileSettings.creditReplacementPerMax)){result.credits+=100;continue;}
    const options=getOptions(shadow).filter(choice=>choice.weapon&&!choice.weapon.isSynergy);
    let selected=null;
    const allowNew=random()<fileSettings.newChance;
    for(let attempt=0;attempt<5&&!selected;attempt++) {
      let kind=random()<fileSettings.weaponChance?'weapon':'item';
      const pool=k=>options.filter(option=>{
        const category=/item|equipment/i.test(option.category||'')?'item':'weapon';
        const owned=(k==='item'?shadow.equipmentSlots:shadow.attackSlots).some(w=>w?.id===option.weapon.id);
        return category===k&&(owned||(allowNew&&free[k]>index));
      });
      let candidates=pool(kind);if(!candidates.length&&kind==='weapon'){kind='item';candidates=pool(kind);}
      if(candidates.length){const choice=candidates[Math.min(candidates.length-1,Math.floor(random()*candidates.length))];selected={...choice,kind};}
    }
    if(selected&&acceptFileProduct(shadow,selected))result.products.push(selected);else result.credits+=100;
  }
  return result;
}

import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
import { createBitmapText } from './bitmap-font.js';
import { ensurePlayerStats } from './player-stats.js';

/** Shared stat labels, icons and formatting for Pause and Crafter screens. */
export const characterStatRows = [
  ['HP','Bond.png',p=>`${Math.ceil(p.hp)}/${p.maxHp}`],
  ['ATK','Tournament Water Gun.png',p=>`+${p.combatStats?.atkPercent||0}%`],
  ['SPD','Crew Whistle.png',p=>`+${(Number(p.combatStats?.spdPercent)||0)+(p.tuningParts?tuningPerk(p.tuningParts,'characterSpeedPercent'):0)}%`],
  ['CRT','Event 27 - 10 Sided Dice.png',p=>`${Number(Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Object.values(p.combatBuffs||{}).reduce((sum,buff)=>sum+(Number(buff?.critPercent)||0),Number(p.combatStats?.critPercent)||0))).toFixed(2))}%`],
  ['Pickup','Event 06 - Buff 14.png',p=>`+${p.combatStats?.pickupPercent||0}%`],
  ['Haste','Skill Book Node.png',p=>`+${p.combatStats?.hastePercent||0}%`]
];

/** Bind existing Pause markup, or build the identical holographic panel for another menu. */
export function createCharacterStatsPanel({root,portrait,nameCanvas,rowsContainer,scale=1}) {
  if(!portrait||!nameCanvas||!rowsContainer) {
    root.replaceChildren();
    portrait=document.createElement('img');portrait.className='pause-hologram';portrait.alt='';
    const content=document.createElement('div');content.className='pause-stat-content';
    nameCanvas=document.createElement('canvas');rowsContainer=document.createElement('div');
    content.append(nameCanvas,rowsContainer);root.append(portrait,content);
  }
  const name=createBitmapText(nameCanvas,{variant:'font2',scale:1.2*scale});
  rowsContainer.replaceChildren();
  const rows=characterStatRows.map(([label,file,value])=>{
    const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='pause-stat-row';
    const icon=document.createElement('img');icon.alt='';icon.src=`../sprites/icons/${file}`;
    const labelCanvas=document.createElement('canvas'),valueCanvas=document.createElement('canvas');
    const labelText=createBitmapText(labelCanvas,{variant:'font2',scale:1.1*scale});
    const valueText=createBitmapText(valueCanvas,{variant:'font2',scale:1.1*scale});
    labelText.setText(label);row.append(icon,labelCanvas,valueCanvas);rowsContainer.append(row);
    return {value,valueText};
  });
  return {
    /** Read the current character each time a menu opens; never reuse stale HP or bonuses. */
    update(player) {
      const character=ensurePlayerStats(player);name.setText(character.label||'Character');
      for(const row of rows)row.valueText.setText(row.value(character));
      const label=String(character.label||'').toLowerCase();
      const source=label.includes('plana')?'../sprites/Plana_Portrait.png':label.includes('arona')?'../sprites/Arona_Portrait.png':'';
      portrait.hidden=!source;if(source)portrait.src=source;
    }
  };
}

import { firebaseConfig } from './firebase-config.js';

let authPromise;

/** Load Firebase once and share the same Authentication instance across callers. */
export function getFirebaseAuth() {
  const requiredFields = ['apiKey', 'authDomain', 'projectId', 'appId'];

  if (requiredFields.some(field => !firebaseConfig[field]?.trim())) {
    const error = new Error('Firebase web configuration is missing.');
    error.code = 'app/missing-config';
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }

  if (!authPromise) {
    authPromise = initializeAuthentication().catch(error => {
      // Allow another attempt after a temporary SDK download or startup failure.
      authPromise = undefined;
      throw error;
    });
  }

  return authPromise;
}

import { itemCritPenalty, itemDamageBonus } from './item-catalog.js';
import { tuningPerk, startingWeaponProjectileCount, emptyWeaponSlotCount, weaponTuningDamageBonus, stationaryTuningActive } from './tuning-parts.js';
import { percentBonusFormula, attackDamageFormula, weaponDamageFormula, growthSettings, totalATKFormula, attackStatSettings, totalCritModFormula, bonusDamageTakenFormula, damageBonusFormula, damageReductionFormula, haloDamageFormula, damageModifiersFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { defaultCombatStats, combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
export { defaultCombatStats } from './game-config.js';
// Percent bonuses: zero keeps base values. CRIT is a direct chance percentage.


/** Initialize independent per-character combat stats without resetting upgrades. */
export function ensureCombatStats(character) {
  character.combatStats ??= {};
  character.combatStats.damageBonusMultipliers ??= [];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(defaultCombatStats)) character.combatStats[key] ??= value;
  return character.combatStats;
}

/** Convert a bonus percentage to a multiplier (25% means 1.25 times base). */
export function statMultiplier(character, key) {
  const value = Number(ensureCombatStats(character)[key]);
  if (key === 'atkPercent') return totalCharacterATK(character) / 100;
  return percentBonusFormula(value+(key==='spdPercent'&&character.tuningParts?tuningPerk(character.tuningParts,'characterSpeedPercent'):0));
}

/** Roll per-hit critical chance; target debuffs add percentage points before clamping. */
export function rollAttackDamage(character, totalWeaponDamage, random = Math.random,
  { damageMod = 1, forceCritical = false, targetCritBonus = 0, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent = 0, target, weaponId } = {}) {
  const stats = ensureCombatStats(character);
  const buffs=Object.values(character.combatBuffs||{}).filter(Boolean);
  const bonusCrit=buffs.reduce((sum,buff)=>sum+(Number(buff.critPercent)||0),0);
  const critical = forceCritical || random() < Math.max(0, Math.min(100, stats.critPercent + bonusCrit + targetCritBonus - itemCritPenalty(character) + startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'critChancePercent'))) / 100;
  const combinedModifier = damageModifiersFormula({
    criticalMultiplier: critical ? characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent + startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'critDamagePercent')) : 1,
    bonusDamageTaken: bonusDamageTakenFormula([].concat(target?.bonusDamageTakenPercent??[],target?.weakRemaining>0?target.weakDefensePercent:0)),
    DB: damageBonusFormula([...stats.damageBonusMultipliers,itemDamageBonus(character),...buffs.map(buff=>buff.damageBonusMultiplier).filter(Number.isFinite)]),
    DR: damageReductionFormula(target?.damageReductionPercent ?? []),
    halo: characterHaloMultiplier(character, target),
    attackModifier: damageMod // Attack-specific effects, including EX drawing accuracy.
  });

/** User will supply five recipes. No placeholder weapons/items are invented.
 * Shape: {id,synergyId,itemId,result:{id,name,...},description,createWeapon?}.
 * Super Items may identify their base ingredient through baseItemId.
 */
export const superSynergyRecipes=[];
import {superSynergyRecipes} from './super-synergy-recipes.js';
export const superSynergySettings={minimumLevel:50,synergyThreshold:3,maxCrafts:1};
export function createSuperSynergyRun(){return {hammer:'none',hammerCreated:false,crafted:false,groundPosition:null};}
export const superSynergyRun=createSuperSynergyRun();
export function superSynergyProgress(player,state=superSynergyRun,recipes=superSynergyRecipes){
  if(state.crafted)return {stage:'complete',frame:null};
  const weapons=(player.attackSlots||[]).filter(Boolean),count=weapons.filter(w=>w.isSynergy&&!w.isSuperSynergy).length;
  const eligible=recipes.some(recipe=>weapons.some(w=>w.id===recipe.synergyId));
  if(state.hammer==='held')return {stage:'hammer',frame:2};
  if(!eligible)return {stage:'hidden',frame:null};
  return {stage:count>=2?'shaft':'half-shaft',frame:count>=2?1:0,
    earn:!state.hammerCreated?(count>=3?'held':(player.level||1)>=50?'ground':null):null};
}
export function advanceSuperSynergyProgress(player,state=superSynergyRun,recipes=superSynergyRecipes){
  const progress=superSynergyProgress(player,state,recipes);
  if(progress.earn){state.hammerCreated=true;state.hammer=progress.earn;}
  return superSynergyProgress(player,state,recipes);
}
export function collectGoldenHammer(state=superSynergyRun){
  if(state.hammer!=='ground'||state.crafted)return false;
  state.hammer='held';state.groundPosition=null;return true;
}
function validItem(item,id){
  return item&&(item.id===id||item.baseItemId===id)&&
    (item.isSuper===true||item.super===true||item.superItem===true||(Number.isFinite(item.maxLevel)&&(item.level||1)>=item.maxLevel));
}
export function superSynergyChoices(player,state=superSynergyRun,recipes=superSynergyRecipes){
  if(state.crafted||state.hammer!=='held')return [];
  const choices=[];for(const recipe of recipes){
    if(!recipe.id||!recipe.result?.id||player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id===recipe.result.id))continue;
    for(let a=0;a<Math.min(6,player.attackSlots?.length||0);a++){
      if(player.attackSlots[a]?.id!==recipe.synergyId)continue;
      for(let b=0;b<Math.min(6,player.equipmentSlots?.length||0);b++){
        if(!validItem(player.equipmentSlots[b],recipe.itemId))continue;
        choices.push({id:`super-synergy:${recipe.id}:${a}:${b}`,name:recipe.result.name||recipe.result.id,label:'Super Synnergize',kind:'super-synergy',target:recipe.result,recipe,slots:[a,6+b],disabled:false,
          description:recipe.description||`Fuse ${player.attackSlots[a].name||recipe.synergyId} and ${player.equipmentSlots[b].name||recipe.itemId}.`});
      }
    }
  }return choices;
}
export function applySuperSynergyChoice(player,id,state=superSynergyRun,recipes=superSynergyRecipes){
  const choice=superSynergyChoices(player,state,recipes).find(c=>c.id===id);
  if(!choice)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'Super Synnergy requirements are not met.'};
  let result;try{result=choice.recipe.createWeapon?choice.recipe.createWeapon():{...choice.recipe.result};}catch{return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'Super Synnergy unavailable.'};}
  if(result?.id!==choice.recipe.result.id)return {consumed:false,success:false,message:'Super Synnergy unavailable.'};
  const [weaponSlot,itemSlot]=choice.slots;
  player.attackSlots[weaponSlot]={...result,level:result.level||1,isSynergy:true,isSuperSynergy:true,consumedWeaponIds:[choice.recipe.synergyId],consumedItemIds:[choice.recipe.itemId]};
  player.equipmentSlots[itemSlot-6]=null;
  state.hammer='used';state.crafted=true;state.hammerCreated=true;state.groundPosition=null;
  return {consumed:true,success:true,message:`${result.name||result.id} created!`};
}
import {stationaryWeaponIntervalScale} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {startingWeaponAim} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {rgbTuningActive,rainbowTrailGradient} from './rgb-tuning.js';
import { createEnemySpatialIndex } from './enemy-spatial-index.js';
import { princessKeySettings as settings, luminousNovaSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';

import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';

/** Stagger four independently critting rounds across each three-frame cycle; ignore Haste. */
export function createPrincessKeyAttack({random=Math.random}={}) {
  let bullets=[],owner=null,cooldown=0,enabled=true,shots=0,gaps=[],shotIndex=0,exMode='normal';
  let stationaryScale=1;
  function reset(){stationaryScale=1;bullets=[];owner=null;cooldown=0;shots=0;gaps=[];shotIndex=0;}
  function update(delta,player,aim=0,viewport=null) {
    if(!player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id==='princess-key')){reset();return;}
    if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
    const intervalScale=player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1;
    if(intervalScale!==stationaryScale){cooldown*=intervalScale/stationaryScale;gaps=gaps.map(gap=>gap*intervalScale/stationaryScale);stationaryScale=intervalScale;}
    if((!enabled&&exMode==='normal')||delta<=0)return;
    if(player.tuningParts)aim=startingWeaponAim(player,'princess-key',aim);
    const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
    const view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};
    let remaining=delta;
    while(remaining>1e-8) {
      if(cooldown<=1e-8) {
        const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
        if(shotIndex===0) {
          // Positive randomized gaps sum to exactly one base cycle, preserving total fire rate.
          const weights=Array.from({length:settings.attackCount},()=>.7+random()*.6);
          const total=weights.reduce((sum,value)=>sum+value,0);
          gaps=weights.map(value=>settings.interval*stationaryScale*value/total/(exMode==='beam' ? settings.exFireRateMultiplier : 1));
        }
        {
          const angle=aim+(random()-.5)*settings.spreadRadians*(exMode==='beam'?settings.exSpreadMultiplier:1);
          const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
          const offset=1/Math.hypot(dx/body.rx,dy/body.ry)+3+settings.diameter*1.8;
          bullets.push({x:body.x+dx*offset,y:body.y+dy*offset,angle,rainbowPhase:shots*.618,rainbow:player.tuningParts?rgbTuningActive(player):false,color:exMode==='beam'?'blue':'pink',
            pierceLimit:exMode==='beam'?Infinity:settings.hitLimit,speed:settings.speed,age:0,hits:new Map(),hitCount:0});shots++;
        }
        cooldown=gaps[shotIndex];shotIndex=(shotIndex+1)%settings.attackCount;
      }
      const step=Math.min(remaining,cooldown,1/60);
      const index=createEnemySpatialIndex(getAllEnemies(),getEnemyHurtbox);
      for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
        const bullet=bullets[i],from={x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y},dt=step;
        bullet.age+=dt;bullet.x+=Math.cos(bullet.angle)*settings.speed*dt;bullet.y+=Math.sin(bullet.angle)*settings.speed*dt;
        for(const enemy of index.querySegment(from,bullet,settings.diameter*1.8)) {
          if(bullet.hitCount>=bullet.pierceLimit)break;
          if(bullet.age-(bullet.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<settings.hitCooldown||!luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,bullet,settings.diameter*1.8))continue;
          bullet.hits.set(enemy.id,bullet.age);bullet.hitCount++;
          const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'princess-key',settings.damageMultiplier,[],{projectileCount:4,hitCooldownFrames:15}),random,{target:enemy});
          const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,damageGroup:'princess-key'}),living=getEnemy(enemy.id);
          if(landed!==false&&living)applySkillControl(living,Math.cos(bullet.angle)*settings.knockbackSpeed*settings.knockbackSeconds,
            Math.sin(bullet.angle)*settings.knockbackSpeed*settings.knockbackSeconds,settings.knockbackSeconds,settings.knockbackSeconds);
        }
        if(princessBulletOffscreen(bullet,view)||bullet.hitCount>=bullet.pierceLimit)bullets.splice(i,1);
      }
      remaining-=step;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);
    }
  }
  return {ready:Promise.resolve(),reset,update,
    setExMode(active,shooting) {
      const next=active&&shooting?'beam':'normal';
      if(next===exMode)return;
      // Preserve all in-flight rounds and the current firing phase while changing new shots.
      const oldRate=exMode==='beam'?settings.exFireRateMultiplier:1;
      const newRate=next==='beam'?settings.exFireRateMultiplier:1;
      cooldown*=oldRate/newRate;gaps=gaps.map(gap=>gap*oldRate/newRate);
      exMode=next;
    },
    // Reuse Kei's actual plasma renderer: identical pink bloom and continuous tapered tail.
    draw(context,camera){const rainbow=Boolean(owner?.tuningParts&&rgbTuningActive(owner));for(const bullet of bullets){bullet.rainbow=rainbow;drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,settings.diameter,Infinity);}},
    setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);if(!enabled)bullets=[];},
    get shotsFired(){return shots;},get projectileCount(){return bullets.length;}};
}

/** Despawn only after the complete head bloom and continuous tail clear the current camera. */
export function princessBulletOffscreen(bullet,view) {
  const radius=settings.diameter/2,padding=radius*luminousNovaSettings.bloomRadiusScale;
  const length=Math.min(radius*(1+luminousNovaSettings.trailLengthRatio),settings.speed*bullet.age);
  const tailX=bullet.x-Math.cos(bullet.angle)*length,tailY=bullet.y-Math.sin(bullet.angle)*length;
  return Math.max(bullet.x,tailX)+padding<view.x||Math.min(bullet.x,tailX)-padding>view.x+view.width||
    Math.max(bullet.y,tailY)+padding<view.y||Math.min(bullet.y,tailY)-padding>view.y+view.height;
}

import { recognizeAdminDigit, adminSkillResult } from './admin-skills.js';
import { recognizeLoadoutPattern, closestDrawingSkill } from './skill-pattern-recognition.js';
import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { createSkillCastState, advanceSkillCooldowns, readySkill, equippedSkills, setSkillCooldown } from './skill-cast-state.js';
import { createDrawingRecognizer } from './drawing-recognizer.js';
import { drawSkillStrokes } from './skill-drawing.js';
import { pointerToCanvas } from './aiming.js';

/** Connect right-click casting, sketch input, recognition and per-weapon cooldowns. */
export function createSkillCasting({ canvas, aiming, getPlayer, getCharacters, isPaused,
  recognizer = createDrawingRecognizer(), getCastAngle = () => 0, onRecognized = () => {} }) {
  const overlay = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-overlay');
  const drawingCanvas = document.querySelector('#skill-drawing-canvas');
  const context = drawingCanvas.getContext('2d');
  const timer = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-timer');
  const bar = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-bar');
  const fill = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-fill');
  const status = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-status');
  const feedback = document.querySelector('#skill-feedback');
  let feedbackTimeout;

  /** Surface recognition/cancellation feedback without requiring the admin panel to be open. */
  function setStatus(text) {
    status.textContent = text;
    if (!feedback) return;
    feedback.textContent = text; feedback.hidden = false;
    clearTimeout(feedbackTimeout);
    feedbackTimeout = setTimeout(() => { feedback.hidden = true; }, 6000);
  }
  let strokes = [], activeStroke = null, pointerId = null;
  let adminNumbersForCast = false;
  const numberMode = () => Boolean(document.querySelector('#admin-number-casting')?.checked);
  let penCursor = 'crosshair';
  const penImage = new Image();
  penImage.onload = () => {
    // Native cursor artwork must be small; align its hotspot with the pen tip.
    const cursorCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    cursorCanvas.width = 48;
    cursorCanvas.height = Math.round(48 * penImage.naturalHeight / penImage.naturalWidth);
    cursorCanvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(penImage, 0, 0, cursorCanvas.width, cursorCanvas.height);
    penCursor = `url("${cursorCanvas.toDataURL('image/png')}") 20 36, crosshair`;
    if (!overlay.hidden) drawingCanvas.style.cursor = penCursor;
  };
  penImage.src = new URL('../sprites/pen.png', import.meta.url).href;

  const state = createSkillCastState(async request => {
    request.adminNumbers = adminNumbersForCast;
    const sketch = strokes.map(stroke => stroke.map(point => ({ ...point })));
    closeOverlay();
    setStatus('Checking drawing...');
    try {
      const digit = request.adminNumbers ? recognizeAdminDigit(sketch) : null;
      const result = request.adminNumbers
        ? digit ? adminSkillResult(request.owner, digit - 1) : { valid: false, reason: 'Draw a number from 1 to 6.' }
        : await recognizeLoadoutPattern(sketch, equippedSkills(request.owner), recognizer,
          () => request.token === state.token);
      if (request.token !== state.token) return;
      const accepted = state.resolve(request.token, result);
      if (accepted) {
        // Read restored targeting after recognition, rather than stale drawing-mode facing.
        const angle = getCastAngle();
        setStatus(`${result.label}! Accuracy: ${Math.round(result.accuracy * 100)}% | ${result.damageMultiplier.toFixed(2)}x damage. Cooldown: 3:00.`);
        onRecognized({ player: request.owner, weapon: result.weapon, angle,
          skillId: result.skillId, accuracy: result.accuracy, damageMultiplier: result.damageMultiplier,
          clipPredictions: result.clipPredictions, predictions: [{ label: result.label, score: result.score }], components: result.components });
      } else setStatus(`${result.reason || 'Drawing not recognized.'} No cooldown applied.`);
    } catch (error) {
      if (request.token !== state.token) return;
      state.resolve(request.token, null);
      setStatus(`Recognition unavailable: ${error.message} No cooldown applied.`);
    }
  });

  /** Restore the previous cursor-aim preference and release the drawing pointer. */
  function closeOverlay() {
    overlay.hidden = true;
    aiming.setDirectionalOverride(false);
    if (pointerId !== null && drawingCanvas.hasPointerCapture?.(pointerId)) drawingCanvas.releasePointerCapture(pointerId);
    activeStroke = null; pointerId = null;
  }

  /** Empty cancellation is free; ink penalties target its closest ready skill instead of a default slot. */
  function cancel(reason) {
    const target = state.inkLength > 0 ? closestDrawingSkill(strokes, equippedSkills(state.owner)) : null;
    if (!state.cancel(reason, target)) return;
    closeOverlay();
    const applied = target?.skillCooldownRemaining > 0;
    setStatus(applied ? `${target.name || 'Skill'} cancelled: ${Math.ceil(target.skillCooldownRemaining)}s cooldown.`
      : 'Cast cancelled. No cooldown applied.');
  }

  /** Open the configured drawing window without freezing movement or enemies. */
  function toggleCast(event) {

    // Start the download early; recognition retries after a temporary loading error.

  }

  /** Convert pointer positions to fixed canvas coordinates, including scaled previews. */
  function point(event) {

    return { x: Math.max(0, Math.min(drawingCanvas.width, result.x)),
      y: Math.max(0, Math.min(drawingCanvas.height, result.y)) };
  }
  /** Preserve cursor aim between strokes; force facing only while ink is being drawn. */
  function updateDrawingAim(event) {

    aiming.setDirectionalOverride(drawing);

  }
  drawingCanvas.addEventListener('pointerenter', updateDrawingAim);

  drawingCanvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {

  });
  drawingCanvas.addEventListener('pointermove', event => {

      const distance = Math.hypot(next.x - previous.x, next.y - previous.y);
      if (distance < 0.75) continue;
      activeStroke.push(next); state.addInk(distance);
    }
    drawSkillStrokes(context, strokes, drawingCanvas.width, drawingCanvas.height);
  });
  function finishStroke(event) {
    if (event.pointerId !== pointerId) return;
    if (activeStroke && state.phase === 'drawing') {
      const next = point(event), previous = activeStroke.at(-1);
      const distance = Math.hypot(next.x - previous.x, next.y - previous.y);
      if (distance >= 0.75) { activeStroke.push(next); state.addInk(distance); }
      drawSkillStrokes(context, strokes, drawingCanvas.width, drawingCanvas.height);
    }
    if (drawingCanvas.hasPointerCapture(pointerId)) drawingCanvas.releasePointerCapture(pointerId);
    activeStroke = null; pointerId = null; state.strokeEnd();
    updateDrawingAim(event);
  }
  drawingCanvas.addEventListener('pointerup', finishStroke);
  drawingCanvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', finishStroke);

/** Require interior ink in both symbol regions before allowing CLIP to rescue rough geometry. */
function hasBothSymbols(strokes) {
  const b = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!b) return false;
  const cx = (b.left + b.right) / 2, cy = (b.top + b.bottom) / 2;
  const w = b.right - b.left, h = b.bottom - b.top;
  if (!(w > 0) || !(h > 0)) return false;
  const inner = strokes.flat().filter(p => Math.hypot((p.x-cx)/(w/2), (p.y-cy)/(h/2)) < .76);
  return inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x > cx+w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x > cx+w*.04);
}

/** Combine full-symbol CLIP, isolated QuickDraw parts and forgiving spatial validation. */
export async function recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  if(weapon?.id==='princess-key')return recognizePrincessKeyPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'luminous-nova') return recognizeLuminousNovaPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'aris-laser') return recognizeSupernovaPattern(strokes, recognizer, isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id !== 'plana-umbrella') return { valid: false, reason: 'No drawing skill is defined for this weapon yet.' };
  // CLIP can confuse overlapping frames with Umbrella's enclosing circle. Local geometry wins.
  if(linkedFrameEvidence(strokes))return {valid:false,reason:'This is a linked-frame pattern, not Umbrella.'};
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const pattern = segmentPlanaPattern(strokes);
  const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes);
  let clipPredictions = [], clipError;
  try {
    if (recognizer.recognizeSymbol) clipPredictions = await recognizer.recognizeSymbol(drawingModelImage(strokes));
  } catch (error) {
    // Download/inference failure must not disable an otherwise recognized geometric cast.
    clipError = error.message;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  const clipMatch = clipPredictions[0]?.label === 'a hand drawn circle enclosing an arrow above an X cross' &&
    clipPredictions[0].score >= skillCastSettings.clipMinimumScore;
  const rescued = clipMatch && accuracy >= skillCastSettings.referenceMinimum && hasBothSymbols(strokes);
  if (!pattern.valid && !rescued) return { ...pattern, clipPredictions, accuracy };
  const components = [];
  // When geometry cannot reliably split rough ink, ask QuickDraw about the whole sketch.
  const parts = pattern.valid ? pattern.parts : [{ name: 'whole pattern', strokes }];
  for (const part of parts) {
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    try {
      const predictions = await recognizer.recognize(drawingModelImage(part.strokes));
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions });
    } catch (error) {
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions: [], error: error.message });
    }
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  return { valid: true, skillId: 'plana-umbrella-launch', label: 'Plana: Umbrella Launch',
    score: pattern.valid ? pattern.score : clipPredictions[0].score,
    accuracy, damageMultiplier: skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy), components, clipPredictions, clipError };
}


/** Let the drawing identify a ready EX skill; autoattacks never require weapon selection. */
export async function recognizeLoadoutPattern(strokes, skills, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  let bestMatch = null, bestFailure = null;
  const validMatches = [];
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    const result = await recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent);
    const accuracy = weapon.id==='princess-key'?drawingAccuracy(strokes,princessKeyReferenceStrokes()):weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes, supernovaReferenceStrokes()) :
      weapon.id === 'luminous-nova' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,luminousNovaReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'plana-umbrella' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes) : 0;
    const candidate = {...result, weapon, matchAccuracy: result.matchAccuracy??accuracy};
    if (result.valid) validMatches.push(candidate);
    if (result.valid && (!bestMatch || candidate.matchAccuracy > bestMatch.matchAccuracy)) bestMatch = candidate;
    if (!bestFailure || accuracy > bestFailure.matchAccuracy) bestFailure = candidate;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  validMatches.sort((a,b)=>b.matchAccuracy-a.matchAccuracy);
  if (validMatches.length > 1 && validMatches[0].matchAccuracy-validMatches[1].matchAccuracy < skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin) {
    return {valid:false,reason:'Drawing is ambiguous. Please try again.'};
  }
  return bestMatch || bestFailure || {valid:false,reason:'No ready skill matches this pattern.'};
}

/** Add prior beam damage once, after the normal per-hit damage roll. No percentage or cap. */
export function princessBeamTickDamage(base,previousBeamDamage) {
  return Math.max(0,Math.round(base+previousBeamDamage));
}

/** Gentle blue residue pulse, followed by an inward collapse at the four-second detonation. */
export function princessResiduePose(age) {
  const progress=Math.min(1,age/settings.residueSeconds);
  if(age>=settings.residueSeconds) {
    const t=Math.min(1,(age-settings.residueSeconds)/.4);
    return {radius:6+(settings.residueRadius-6)*(1-(1-t)**3),opacity:.24*(1-t)**2,exploded:true};
  }
  const collapse=Math.max(0,(age-(settings.residueSeconds-.4))/.4);
  return {radius:Math.max(1,24*(.96+.04*Math.sin(age*4))*(1-collapse*collapse)),
    opacity:.18*(1-progress*.5)*(.94+.06*Math.sin(age*4)),exploded:false};
}
