import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** List equipped weapon skills and an optional future ultimate, each with its own timer. */
export function equippedSkills(character) {
  return [...(character.attackSlots || []), character.ultimateSkill].filter(skill => skill?.icon && skill.exSkill !== false);
}

/** Find availability only; this does not select or equip a weapon. */
export function readySkill(character) {
  return equippedSkills(character).find(skill => !(skill.skillCooldownRemaining > 0));
}

/** Put a cooldown on the exact weapon that initiated a cast, independently of other weapons. */
export function setSkillCooldown(weapon, seconds) {
  weapon.skillCooldownDuration = seconds;
  weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = seconds;
}

/** Tick each equipped weapon once; global pause freezes these timers in the game loop. */
export function advanceSkillCooldowns(characters, delta) {
  const visited = new Set();
  for (const character of characters) for (const weapon of equippedSkills(character)) {
    if (!weapon || visited.has(weapon)) continue;
    visited.add(weapon);
    weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = Math.max(0, (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining || 0) - Math.max(0, delta));
  }
}

/** Drawing-cast state machine; async recognition responses must match the current token. */
export function createSkillCastState(onSubmit = () => {}) {
  let phase = 'idle', owner = null, weapon = null;
  let elapsed = 0, idle = 0, drawing = false, inkLength = 0, token = 0;
  return {
    get phase() { return phase; }, get owner() { return owner; }, get weapon() { return weapon; },
    get token() { return token; }, get inkLength() { return inkLength; },
    get remaining() { return Math.max(0, skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds - elapsed); },
    begin(character, item, adminTest = false) {
      if (phase !== 'idle' || !item?.icon || (!adminTest && item.skillCooldownRemaining > 0)) return false;
      owner = character; weapon = item; elapsed = idle = inkLength = 0; drawing = false;
      phase = 'drawing'; token++;
      return true;
    },
    strokeStart() { if (phase === 'drawing') { drawing = true; idle = 0; } },
    addInk(length) { if (phase === 'drawing') { inkLength += Math.max(0, length); idle = 0; } },
    strokeEnd() { drawing = false; idle = 0; },
    update(delta) {
      if (phase !== 'drawing') return;
      const time = Math.max(0, delta);
      elapsed += time;
      if (!drawing && inkLength > 0) idle += time;
      if (elapsed >= skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds || idle >= skillCastSettings.idleSubmitSeconds) {
        if (inkLength <= skillCastSettings.minimumInkLength) { this.cancel('empty'); return; }
        phase = 'recognizing'; drawing = false;
        onSubmit({ token, owner, weapon });
      }
    },
    cancel(reason, target = weapon) {
      if (phase === 'idle') return false;
      const penalty = reason === 'pause' ? skillCastSettings.pauseCancelCooldown
        : reason === 'right' ? skillCastSettings.rightCancelCooldown
        : reason === 'empty' ? skillCastSettings.failureCooldown : 0;
      if (penalty && inkLength > 0 && target && equippedSkills(owner).includes(target) &&
          !(target.skillCooldownRemaining > 0)) setSkillCooldown(target, penalty);
      token++; phase = 'idle'; drawing = false;
      return true;
    },
    resolve(requestToken, result) {
      if (requestToken !== token || phase !== 'recognizing') return false;
      let valid = Boolean(result && result.valid !== false && typeof result.label === 'string' && result.label.length > 0 &&
        Number.isFinite(result.score) && result.score >= skillCastSettings.minimumConfidence);
      if (valid && result.weapon) {
        if (!equippedSkills(owner).includes(result.weapon) || (!result.adminTest && result.weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0)) valid = false;
        else weapon = result.weapon;
      }
      // Unknown/ambiguous/failed recognition is free; never penalize a guessed weapon.
      if (valid) setSkillCooldown(weapon, skillCastSettings.successCooldown);
      if (valid) {
        weapon.lastSkillDrawing = { label: result.label, score: result.score, skillId: result.skillId, components: result.components,
          accuracy: result.accuracy, damageMultiplier: result.damageMultiplier, clipPredictions: result.clipPredictions };
      }
      phase = 'idle'; token++;
      return Boolean(valid);
    }
  };
}

/** Match handwritten 1Ã¢â‚¬â€œ6 locally, without downloading or calling either AI model. */
export function recognizeAdminDigit(strokes) {
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return null;
  const width = bounds.right - bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
  if (height > 0 && width / height < .18) return 1;
  const ranked = Object.entries(adminDigitTemplates).map(([digit, template]) =>
    ({ digit: Number(digit), score: drawingAccuracy(strokes, template) })).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  return ranked[0].score >= .45 && ranked[0].score - ranked[1].score >= .025 ? ranked[0].digit : null;
}

/** Resolve a slot only when it contains a weapon with an implemented EX effect. */
export function adminSkillResult(player, slot) {
  const weapon = player.attackSlots?.[slot];
  const skillId = skillIds[weapon?.id];
  return skillId ? { valid: true, adminTest: true, weapon, skillId,
    label: weapon.name || weapon.id, score: 1, accuracy: skillCastSettings.accuracyAverage,
    damageMultiplier: skillCastSettings.damageAverage, components: [] }
    : { valid: false, reason: `Slot ${slot + 1} has no implemented EX skill.` };
}

import { drawingBounds, normalizeSkillStrokes } from './skill-drawing.js';

/** Canonical pattern matching the EX Skills reference diagram. */
export function planaReferenceStrokes() {
  return [Array.from({ length: 97 }, (_, i) => ({
    x: 100 + 86 * Math.cos(i / 96 * Math.PI * 2),
    y: 100 + 86 * Math.sin(i / 96 * Math.PI * 2)
  })), [{ x: 100, y: 94 }, { x: 100, y: 43 }],
  [{ x: 76, y: 67 }, { x: 100, y: 43 }, { x: 124, y: 67 }],
  [{ x: 75, y: 119 }, { x: 125, y: 160 }],
  [{ x: 125, y: 119 }, { x: 75, y: 160 }]];
}

/** Uniformly sample ink length, ignoring pen speed, stroke order and direction. */
function normalizedInk(strokes) {
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return [];
  const size = Math.max(bounds.right - bounds.left, bounds.bottom - bounds.top, 1);
  const points = [];
  for (const stroke of strokes) for (let i = 1; i < stroke.length; i++) {
    const a = stroke[i - 1], b = stroke[i];
    const count = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) / size * 180));
    for (let j = 0; j <= count; j++) points.push({
      x: (a.x + (b.x - a.x) * j / count - (bounds.left + bounds.right) / 2) / size,
      y: (a.y + (b.y - a.y) * j / count - (bounds.top + bounds.bottom) / 2) / size
    });
  }
  // Bound comparison work even for very long mouse strokes.
  const unique = [...new Map(points.map(p => [
    `${Math.round(p.x * 10000)},${Math.round(p.y * 10000)}`, p
  ])).values()].sort((a, b) => Math.round(a.x * 10000) - Math.round(b.x * 10000) ||
    Math.round(a.y * 10000) - Math.round(b.y * 10000));
  return unique.filter((_, i) => i % Math.max(1, Math.ceil(unique.length / 320)) === 0);

/** Load the original PNGs once; compose crossed icons directly instead of embedding SVG images. */
export function drawSynergyIcon(canvas,item,isCurrent=()=>true) {
  if(item?.id!=='princess-key')return false;
  const layers=[
    {id:'aris-laser',name:'Arisu',angle:-Math.PI/4,color:'#65cfff',crop:[138,12,678,217]},
    {id:'luminous-nova',name:'Kei',angle:-3*Math.PI/4,color:'#ff71d5',crop:[130,2,716,226]}
  ];
  layers.sort((a,b)=>Number(a.id===item.synergyTopWeaponId)-Number(b.id===item.synergyTopWeaponId));
  Promise.all(layers.map(layer=>{
    const source=`../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_${layer.name}.png`;
    if(!imageCache.has(source)) {
      const image=new Image();image.src=source;
      imageCache.set(source,image.decode().then(()=>image));
    }
    return imageCache.get(source);
  })).then(images=>{
    if(!isCurrent())return;
    const context=canvas.getContext('2d');context.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    layers.forEach((layer,index)=>{
      const [x,y,width,height]=layer.crop;
      const bound=(width+height)/Math.SQRT2,scale=canvas.width*.86/bound;
      context.save();context.translate(canvas.width/2,canvas.height/2);context.rotate(layer.angle);
      context.shadowColor=layer.color;
      // Icons are composed once: layered silhouette glows remain vivid at small HUD sizes.
      for(const blur of [.09,.045,0]) {
        context.shadowBlur=canvas.width*blur;
        context.drawImage(images[index],x,y,width,height,-width*scale/2,-height*scale/2,width*scale,height*scale);
      }
      context.restore();
    });
  }).catch(()=>{});
  return true;
}

/** Apply damage and trigger a brief sprite pulse; remove defeated test enemies. */
export function damageEnemy(id, amount, source, hitType = 'normal', options = {}) {
  const enemy = enemies.get(id);
  if (!enemy || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
  if (options.instantKO && (isBossEnemy(enemy) || enemy.miniBoss || enemy.instantKOImmune)) return false;
  if (options.canMiss && midoriDodges(enemy, source)) {
    showDamageNumber(enemy, 0, false, 'miss');
    return false;
  }
  const mainWeaponId=source?.mainWeaponId??(source?.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  if(source?.tuningParts&&options.weaponId===mainWeaponId)recordRateUpHit(enemy,tuningPerk(source.tuningParts,'rateUpChance'));
  const harmless = ['yuuka','sensei'].includes(enemy.type);
  if (harmless) {
    dropYuukaCredits(enemy); // Each accepted hit, including the final hit.
    enemy.receivedHits = (enemy.receivedHits || 0) + 1;
  }
  const requiredHits = harmless ? (enemy.hitsToDefeat ?? harmlessEnemySettings[`${enemy.type}HitsToDefeat`]) : null;
  const actualDamage=Math.min(enemy.hp,amount);
  enemy.hp = Math.max(0, enemy.hp - amount);
  for(const listener of damageListeners)listener({enemy,source,damage:actualDamage,requestedDamage:amount,hitType});
  // Count accepted hits, not damage points; misses and rejected hits never reach this branch.
  if (Number.isFinite(requiredHits) && requiredHits >= 1 && enemy.receivedHits >= requiredHits) enemy.hp = 0;
  showDamageNumber(enemy, amount, false, hitType, options.damageGroup); // Include overkill and crit styling.
  enemy.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
  if (enemy.hp === 0) {
    const bossesAliveBefore = [...enemies.values()].filter(isBossEnemy).length;
    killCount++;
    dropEnemyExp(enemy);
    dropEnemyLoot(enemy);
    beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source);
    enemies.delete(id);
    for (const listener of defeatListeners) listener({ enemy, bossesAliveBefore });
  }
  return enemy;
}

/** End only this event's enemies with visual deaths, without loot, kills or boss charge. */
export function endEventEnemies(eventKey, source) {
  if (!eventKey) return 0;
  let removed = 0;
  for (const [id, enemy] of enemies) {
    if (enemy.eventKey !== eventKey || isBossEnemy(enemy)) continue;
    beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source, { knockback: false });
    enemies.delete(id);
    removed++;
  }
  return removed;
}

/** Choose a cancellation target locally; empty/unrelated ink never selects a default slot. */
export function closestDrawingSkill(strokes, skills) {
  if (!drawingBounds(strokes)) return null;
  if(linkedFrameEvidence(strokes))return skills.find(w=>w.id==='princess-key'&&!(w.skillCooldownRemaining>0))||null;
  let best = null, score = .25, runnerUp = 0;
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    const reference = weapon.id==='princess-key'?princessKeyReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'luminous-nova'?luminousNovaReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? supernovaReferenceStrokes() : undefined;
    if (!reference && weapon.id !== 'plana-umbrella') continue;
    const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes, reference);
    if (accuracy > score) { runnerUp = score === .25 ? 0 : score; score = accuracy; best = weapon; }
    else runnerUp = Math.max(runnerUp,accuracy);
  }
  return score-runnerUp >= skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin ? best : null;
}

export async function recognizeLoadoutPattern(strokes, skills, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  let bestMatch = null, bestFailure = null;
  const validMatches = [];
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    const result = await recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent);
    const accuracy = ['princess-key','decagrammaton'].includes(weapon.id)?drawingAccuracy(strokes,princessKeyReferenceStrokes()):weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes, supernovaReferenceStrokes()) :
      weapon.id === 'luminous-nova' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,luminousNovaReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'plana-umbrella' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes) : 0;
    const candidate = {...result, weapon, matchAccuracy: result.matchAccuracy??accuracy};
}
export function itemDamageBonus(player) {
  const hat=player.equipmentSlots?.find(item=>item?.id==='malkuth-hat');
  const superBonus=player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id==='decagrammaton')?.3:0;
  return superBonus+(hat?(hat.awakened?1.5:[1.2,1.3,1.4][Math.min(2,Math.max(0,(hat.level||1)-1))]):1);
}

export function enhancedWeaponGlow(weapon) {
  if(!weapon||!(weapon.level>=7))return '';
  return weapon.id==='luminous-nova'?'#ff71d5':weapon.id==='aris-laser'?'#65cfff':'';
}

export function applyEnhancedWeaponGlow(element,weapon) {

}

/** Select a direction-specific walking cycle, or hold frame zero when idle. */
function getAnimationFrame(character) {
  if (character.attack) {
    const attack = character.attacks[character.attack.name];
    return Math.min(character.layout.columnEdges.length - 2,
      Math.floor(character.attack.elapsed / attack.frameDuration));
  }
  if (!character.moving) return 0;
  const frames = character.walkFrames?.[character.direction] ||
    character.frameSequence || [1, 2, 3, 4];
  const duration = character.frameDuration || frameDuration;
  return frames[Math.floor(character.elapsed / duration) % frames.length];
}

/** Blend from the last visible pose without moving the character's world anchor. */
function beginPoseTransition(character) {
  if (character.transitionDuration && character.lastPose) {
    character.transition = { from: character.lastPose, elapsed: 0 };
  }
}

/** Render one pose with shared scale and measured foot anchors, including effects. */
function drawPose(character, pose, opacity) {
  opacity *= character.death?.opacity ?? 1;
  const crop = pose.crop;
  const displaySize = character.spriteSize || spriteSize;
  const scale = (displaySize - spritePadding * 2) / (character.referenceSize || 215);
  const width = crop.width * scale;
  const height = crop.height * scale;
  const drawY = displaySize / 2 - spritePadding - (crop.footY - crop.y) * scale + enemyBounceOffset(character);
  const drawX = crop.anchorX === undefined ? -width / 2 : -(crop.anchorX - crop.x) * scale;
  // Match attack hurtboxes to the rendered pose without changing contact-damage hitboxes.
  character.spriteHurtbox=animationSpriteHurtbox(character,getFrameRectangle,spritePadding);
  context.save();
  context.globalAlpha = opacity;
  context.translate(character.x - camera.x, character.y - camera.y + (character.bossVisualOffsetY||0));
  if(character.bossSquash) {
    const feet=drawY+(crop.footY-crop.y)*scale;
    context.translate(0,feet);
    context.scale(1+(1-character.bossSquash)*.3,character.bossSquash);
    context.translate(0,-feet);
  }
  if (pose.mirrored) context.scale(-1, 1);
  if ((character===characters[selected]||character.isPlayerVisual)&&character.tuningParts&&reverseTuningUpsideDown(character)) {
    const centerY=drawY+height/2;
    context.translate(0,centerY);context.scale(1,-1);context.translate(0,-centerY);
  }
  context.drawImage(character.image, crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height,
    drawX, drawY, width, height);

export const damageFlashDuration = 240; // EDIT total pulse length in milliseconds.
const riseDuration = 45; // Fast gradual rise, followed by a longer fade out.
const whiteSprites = new WeakMap();

/** Return a smooth white-tint intensity, never a full-screen or rectangular flash. */
export function getDamageFlashOpacity(character) {
  const elapsed = character.damageFlashElapsed;
  if (elapsed === undefined || elapsed < 0 || elapsed >= damageFlashDuration) return 0;
  const progress = elapsed < riseDuration
    ? elapsed / riseDuration
    : 1 - (elapsed - riseDuration) / (damageFlashDuration - riseDuration);
  const smooth = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress);
  return smooth * 0.85;
}

    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    const reference = weapon.id==='decagrammaton-ultimate'?decagrammatonReferenceStrokes():['princess-key','decagrammaton'].includes(weapon.id)?princessKeyReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'luminous-nova'?luminousNovaReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? supernovaReferenceStrokes() : undefined;
    if (!reference && weapon.id !== 'plana-umbrella') continue;
    const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes, reference);

/** Shared spherical plasma rendering; the EX changes diameter without changing the normal weapon. */
export function drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,bullet,diameter=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter,duration=luminousNovaSettings.duration) {
  const s=luminousNovaSettings,radius=diameter/2;
  // Preserve gradient opacity and pale hot highlights while tinting the full plasma effect.
  const tint=value=>{
    if(bullet.rainbow)return rainbowPlasmaColor(value,bullet.age*160+(bullet.rainbowPhase||0)*360);
    if(bullet.color==='orange') {
      const orange=(r,g,b)=>[Number(r),Math.round(80+Number(g)*.60),Math.round(Number(g)*.20)];
      if(value.startsWith('#'))return '#'+orange(parseInt(value.slice(1,3),16),parseInt(value.slice(3,5),16),parseInt(value.slice(5,7),16)).map(n=>n.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
      return value.replace(/(rgba?\()(\d+),(\d+),(\d+)/,(_,prefix,r,g,b)=>prefix+orange(r,g,b).join(','));
    }
    return bullet.color!=='blue'?value:value.startsWith('#')
      ? '#'+value.slice(3,5)+value.slice(5,7)+value.slice(1,3)
      : value.replace(/(rgba?\()(\d+),(\d+),(\d+)/, '$1$3,$4,$2');
  };
  // Skip the whole effect once both its head and longest wake have left the canvas.
  const reach=radius*(1+s.trailLengthRatio+s.bloomRadiusScale);
  const screenX=bullet.x-camera.x,screenY=bullet.y-camera.y;
  if(context.canvas&&(screenX+reach<0||screenY+reach<0||screenX-reach>context.canvas.width||screenY-reach>context.canvas.height))return;
  context.save();context.translate(bullet.x-camera.x,bullet.y-camera.y);context.rotate(bullet.angle);
  const fade=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(duration-bullet.age)/.06))*Math.min(1,bullet.age/s.fadeInSeconds);

/** Reference matching is scale/stroke-order independent; QuickDraw supplies supporting shape predictions. */
export async function recognizePrincessKeyPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent=()=>true) {
  const accuracy=drawingAccuracy(strokes,princessKeyReferenceStrokes()),frames=linkedFrameEvidence(strokes);
  if(accuracy<.88&&!frames)return {valid:false,reason:'Draw three interlocking squares.'};
  const components=[];
  try{components.push({name:'linked rectangles',predictions:await recognizer?.recognize(drawingModelImage(strokes))});}catch{}
  if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  return {valid:true,skillId:'princess-key-ex',label:'The Princess and the Key',score:Math.max(accuracy,frames ? .8 : 0),accuracy,matchAccuracy:Math.max(accuracy,frames ? .85 : 0),
    damageMultiplier:skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy),components};
}

/** Separate enclosing ink from diamond ink before combining forgiving geometry and AI assistance. */
export async function recognizeLuminousNovaPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent=()=>true) {
  const normalized=normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes),points=[];
  for(const stroke of normalized)for(let i=1;i<stroke.length;i++) {
    const a=stroke[i-1],b=stroke[i],count=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y)/3));
    for(let j=0;j<=count;j++)points.push({x:a.x+(b.x-a.x)*j/count,y:a.y+(b.y-a.y)*j/count});
  }
  if(!points.length)return {valid:false,reason:'Draw a circle with a diamond inside.'};
  const radius=p=>Math.hypot((p.x-100)/100,(p.y-100)/100);
  const outer=points.filter(p=>radius(p)>.87),inner=points.filter(p=>radius(p)<.84);
  const sectors=new Set(outer.map(p=>(Math.floor((Math.atan2(p.y-100,p.x-100)+Math.PI)/Math.PI*4)+8)%8));
  const bounds=drawingBounds([inner]);

/** Add the accumulated item/skill ATK bonus to the character's independent base ATK. */
export function totalCharacterATK(character) {
  return totalATKFormula(character.baseATK ?? attackStatSettings.baseATK,
    [Number(ensureCombatStats(character).atkPercent)]);
}


/** Add character and weapon critical damage bonuses; overrides replace only the base.
 * criticalMultiplier is an optional weapon base override (e.g. Umbrella LV7=3).
 * critDamagePercent contains accumulated bonuses, separate from critical chance.
 */
export function characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponBonus = 0) {
  const base = criticalMultiplier !== undefined ? (criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100 :
    (character.baseCritMod ?? (combatBalance.criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100);
  const bonus = ensureCombatStats(character).critDamagePercent;
  return Math.max(0, 1 + totalCritModFormula(base, [bonus, weaponBonus]) / 100);
}


/** Measure character-to-target world distance at the hit, never from projectile origin. */
export function characterHaloMultiplier(character, target) {
  if (!target || ![character.x, character.y, target.x, target.y].every(Number.isFinite)) return 1;
  return haloDamageFormula(Math.hypot(target.x - character.x, target.y - character.y), character.haloLevel ?? 0);
}

  const error = (nearestMean(actual, reference) + nearestMean(reference, actual)) / 2;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - error / skillCastSettings.accuracyDistanceTolerance));
}

/** Map successful reference accuracy to minimum/typical/perfect damage anchors. */
export function skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy) {
  const s = skillCastSettings;
  const value = Number.isFinite(accuracy) ? accuracy : s.accuracyAverage;
  const low = value <= s.accuracyAverage;
  const start = low ? s.accuracyMinimum : s.accuracyAverage;
  const end = low ? s.accuracyAverage : s.accuracyPerfect;
  const from = low ? s.damageMinimum : s.damageAverage;
  const to = low ? s.damageAverage : s.damageMaximum;
  return from + (to - from) * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (value - start) / (end - start)));
}

import {superSynergyChoices,applySuperSynergyChoice} from './super-synergy-rules.js';
import { synergyRecipes } from './synergy-recipes.js';
import { umbrellaUpgradeSettings, arisWeaponSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Use each weapon's actual MAX level, including future weapon definitions. */
function maximumLevel(weapon) {
  return weapon.id==='plana-umbrella'?umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel:
    weapon.id==='aris-laser'?arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel:weapon.maxLevel;
}

/** Only compatible, equipped MAX pairs can cause a Golden Crafter drop or fusion choice. */
export function goldenCrafterChoices(player,recipes=synergyRecipes) {
  const slots=player.attackSlots||[],choices=[];
  for(const recipe of recipes) {
    if(!recipe.id||!recipe.result?.id||recipe.ingredients?.length!==2||slots.some(w=>w?.id===recipe.result.id))continue;
    for(let a=0;a<Math.min(6,slots.length);a++)for(let b=a+1;b<Math.min(6,slots.length);b++) {
      const first=slots[a],second=slots[b];if(!first||!second)continue;
      const ids=[first.id,second.id].sort(),needed=[...recipe.ingredients].sort();
      if(ids[0]!==needed[0]||ids[1]!==needed[1])continue;
      if(!Number.isFinite(maximumLevel(first))||!Number.isFinite(maximumLevel(second))||
        (first.level||1)<maximumLevel(first)||(second.level||1)<maximumLevel(second))continue;
      choices.push({id:`synergy:${recipe.id}:${a}:${b}`,name:recipe.result.name||recipe.result.id,
        label:'Fuse MAX weapons',kind:'synergy',target:recipe.result,recipe,slots:[a,b],disabled:false,
        description:recipe.description||`Fuse ${first.name||first.id} and ${second.name||second.id} into ${recipe.result.name||recipe.result.id}.`});
    }
  }
  return [...choices,...(typeof superSynergyChoices==='function'?superSynergyChoices(player):[])];
}

/** Replace the two ingredients with one synergy atomically; cancellation never calls this. */
export function applyGoldenCrafterChoice(player,id,recipes=synergyRecipes) {

import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** List equipped weapon skills and an optional future ultimate, each with its own timer. */
export function equippedSkills(character) {
  const superWeapon=character.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='decagrammaton');
  if(superWeapon&&!character.ultimateSkill)character.ultimateSkill={id:'decagrammaton-ultimate',name:'Band of Atsilut',icon:superWeapon.icon,exSkill:true,successCooldown:300};
  if(!superWeapon&&character.ultimateSkill?.id==='decagrammaton-ultimate')delete character.ultimateSkill;
  return [...(character.attackSlots || []), character.ultimateSkill].filter(skill => skill?.icon && skill.exSkill !== false);
}

/** Find availability only; this does not select or equip a weapon. */
export function readySkill(character) {
  return equippedSkills(character).find(skill => !(skill.skillCooldownRemaining > 0));
}

import { luminousNovaSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { createEnemySpatialIndex } from './enemy-spatial-index.js';
import { luminousNovaHits, drawLuminousPlasma } from './luminous-nova.js';
import { applySkillControl } from './enemy-control.js';

export const decagrammatonSettings={interval:7/60,attackCount:3,speed:15*60,knockbackSeconds:5/60,knockbackSpeed:3*60,
  blue:{damage:.6,hitLimit:7,hitCooldown:15/60,duration:20/60,area:2},
  pink:{damage:.9,hitLimit:3,hitCooldown:1,duration:40/60,area:1.25}};
export function createDecagrammatonWeapon(){return {id:'decagrammaton',name:'Decagrammaton',level:1,maxLevel:1,isSynergy:true,isSuperSynergy:true,
  exSkill:true,icon:'../sprites/attacks/Decagrammaton_Icon.png',consumedWeaponIds:['princess-key','aris-laser','luminous-nova'],consumedItemIds:['malkuth-hat']};}

/** Three primary blue shots per cycle, each paired with one secondary pink shot. */
export function createDecagrammatonAttack({random=Math.random}={}) {
  let bullets=[],owner=null,cooldown=0,enabled=true,shots=0;
  const settings=decagrammatonSettings;
  function reset(){bullets=[];owner=null;cooldown=0;shots=0;}
  function update(delta,player,aim=0,viewport=null){
    if(!player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id==='decagrammaton')){reset();return;}
    if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
    if(delta<=0)return;
    const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};
    let left=delta;
    while(left>1e-8){
      const step=Math.min(left,1/60);left-=step;cooldown-=step;
      const enemies=getAllEnemies();
      if(enabled&&cooldown<=0){
        cooldown+=settings.interval;
        const candidates=enemies.filter(enemy=>{const b=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);return b.x+b.rx>=view.x&&b.x-b.rx<=view.x+view.width&&b.y+b.ry>=view.y&&b.y-b.ry<=view.y+view.height;});
        // Choose among targets near the aim line as well as surrounding enemies.
        const aimed=candidates.slice().sort((a,b)=>{
          const score=e=>{const p=getEnemyHurtbox(e);return Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(Math.atan2(p.y-body.y,p.x-body.x)-aim),Math.cos(Math.atan2(p.y-body.y,p.x-body.x)-aim)));};
          return score(a)-score(b);
        })[0];
        for(let i=0;i<settings.attackCount;i++){
          const target=i===0?aimed:candidates[Math.min(candidates.length-1,Math.floor(random()*candidates.length))];
          for(const color of ['blue','pink']){
            const spec=settings[color],angle=aim+(random()-.5)*12*Math.PI/180;
            const diameter=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter*spec.area;
            const offset=1/Math.hypot(Math.cos(angle)/body.rx,Math.sin(angle)/body.ry)+3;
            bullets.push({x:body.x+Math.cos(angle)*offset,y:body.y+Math.sin(angle)*offset,angle,color,diameter,
              target:color==='blue'?target?.id:null,orbit:random()*Math.PI*2,age:0,speed:settings.speed,hits:new Map(),hitCount:0});shots++;
          }
        }
      }
      const index=createEnemySpatialIndex(enemies,getEnemyHurtbox);
      for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
        const b=bullets[i],spec=settings[b.color],from={x:b.x,y:b.y};b.age+=step;
        const target=b.target?getEnemy(b.target):null;
        if(b.target&&!target){bullets.splice(i,1);continue;}
        if(target){
          const t=getEnemyHurtbox(target),radius=Math.max(t.rx,t.ry)*.65;
          const near=Math.hypot(b.x-t.x,b.y-t.y)<radius+settings.speed*step*2;
          if(near){b.orbit+=step*14;const x=t.x+Math.cos(b.orbit)*radius,y=t.y+Math.sin(b.orbit)*radius;
            b.angle=Math.atan2(y-b.y,x-b.x);b.x=x;b.y=y;
          }else {b.angle=Math.atan2(t.y-b.y,t.x-b.x);b.x+=Math.cos(b.angle)*settings.speed*step;b.y+=Math.sin(b.angle)*settings.speed*step;}
        }else {b.x+=Math.cos(b.angle)*settings.speed*step;b.y+=Math.sin(b.angle)*settings.speed*step;}
        for(const enemy of index.querySegment(from,b,b.diameter*1.8)){
          if(b.hitCount>=spec.hitLimit)break;
          if(b.age-(b.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<spec.hitCooldown||!luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,b,b.diameter*1.8))continue;
          b.hits.set(enemy.id,b.age);b.hitCount++;
          const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'decagrammaton',spec.damage,[],{projectileCount:settings.attackCount,hitCooldownFrames:spec.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target:enemy});
          const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,damageGroup:'decagrammaton'}),living=getEnemy(enemy.id);
          if(landed!==false&&living)applySkillControl(living,Math.cos(b.angle)*settings.knockbackSpeed*settings.knockbackSeconds,Math.sin(b.angle)*settings.knockbackSpeed*settings.knockbackSeconds,settings.knockbackSeconds,settings.knockbackSeconds);
        }
        if(b.age>=spec.duration||b.hitCount>=spec.hitLimit)bullets.splice(i,1);
      }
    }
  }
  return {ready:Promise.resolve(),update,reset,draw(context,camera){for(const b of bullets)drawLuminousPlasma(context,camera,b,b.diameter,decagrammatonSettings[b.color].duration);},
    setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);},get projectileCount(){return bullets.length;},get shotsFired(){return shots;}};
}
  const screenX=bullet.x-camera.x,screenY=bullet.y-camera.y;
  if(context.canvas&&(screenX+reach<0||screenY+reach<0||screenX-reach>context.canvas.width||screenY-reach>context.canvas.height))return;
  context.save();context.translate(bullet.x-camera.x,bullet.y-camera.y);context.rotate(bullet.angle);
  const fade=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(duration-bullet.age)/.06))*Math.min(1,bullet.age/s.fadeInSeconds);
  // Only leave a wake along positions reached after acceleration, never behind the muzzle.
  const wakeAge=bullet.accelerating?Math.max(0,bullet.age-s.accelerationSeconds):bullet.age;
  context.globalAlpha=fade;
  context.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  // A broad soft halo and a tighter luminous rim keep small shots bright without enlarging their core.
  const halo=context.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,radius*3.6);

import { createBitmapText, glyphRectangle } from './bitmap-font.js';
import { getLootTotals } from './exp-drops.js';
import { getKillCount } from './world-state.js';
import { applyEnhancedWeaponGlow } from './weapon-glow.js';
import { drawSynergyIcon } from './synergy-icon.js';

/** Reserve only visible caption ink, accounting for the slot art's top padding. */
export function levelCaptionSpacing(slotWidth, text) {
  const glyphs = [...text].filter(letter => letter !== ' ').map(glyphRectangle);
  const textWidth = [...text].reduce((sum, letter) => sum +
    (letter === ' ' ? 3 : glyphRectangle(letter).width - 1), 1);
  const inkBottom = Math.max(...glyphs.map(glyph => glyph.offsetY + glyph.height));
  const nextBoxInset = slotWidth * (1 - 237 / 255) / 2;
  return Math.max(0, slotWidth * 0.9 * inkBottom / textWidth - 6 - nextBoxInset);
}

/** Keep the equipment frame 2px below the lowest visible attack-level outline. */
function updateCaptionRowSpacing(container, entries) {
  const visible=entries.filter(entry=>!entry.caption.hidden);
  if(!visible.length){container.style.setProperty('--level-space','0px');return;}
  const textWidth=text=>[...text].reduce((sum,letter)=>sum+(letter===' '?3:glyphRectangle(letter).width-1),1);
  // Scale the entire row together. Fitting each label independently makes LV1 and LV7
  // different heights because their digit glyphs have different widths.
  const scale=Math.min(...visible.map(entry=>entry.slot.getBoundingClientRect().width*.9/textWidth(entry.captionText)));
  let spacing = 0;
  for (const entry of visible) {
    entry.caption.style.width=`${textWidth(entry.captionText)*scale}px`;
    entry.caption.style.height=`${20*scale}px`;
    const inkBottom=Math.max(...[...entry.captionText].filter(letter=>letter!==' ').map(letter=>{
      const glyph=glyphRectangle(letter);return glyph.offsetY+glyph.height;
    }));
    const nextBoxInset=entry.slot.getBoundingClientRect().width*(1-237/255)/2;
    spacing=Math.max(spacing,inkBottom*scale-6-nextBoxInset);
  }
  container.style.setProperty('--level-space', `${spacing}px`);
}

      const slot = document.createElement('div');
      slot.className = 'hud-slot';
      slot.setAttribute('role', 'img');

      icon.width = icon.height = 128;
      icon.className = 'hud-slot-icon';
      icon.hidden = true;
      const caption = document.createElement('canvas');

      caption.hidden = true;
      const levelText = createBitmapText(caption, { scale: 1, fitWidth: '90%' });
      const cooldown = document.createElement('div');
      cooldown.className = 'hud-slot-cooldown';
      cooldown.hidden = true; cooldown.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      slot.append(base, cooldown, icon, caption);
      container.append(slot);
      return { slot, base, icon, caption, cooldown, levelText, type, index, previous: null, container };
    });
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => updateCaptionRowSpacing(container, entries));
    observer.observe(container);
    return entries;
  }
  const attackSlots = createSlots(document.querySelector('#hud-attack-slots'), 'attack');
  const equipmentSlots = createSlots(document.querySelector('#hud-equipment-slots'), 'equipment');

  /** Occupied slots use a blank base so placeholder swords/clothes never show through. */
  function updateSlots(slots, items = []) {
    let changed = false;
    for (const entry of slots) {
      const item = items[entry.index];
      entry.slot.classList.toggle('weapon-awakened', Boolean(item?.awakened));

      const source = item?.icon || '';

      entry.cooldown.hidden = remaining <= 0;
      const duration = Math.max(1, item?.skillCooldownDuration || 1);
      entry.cooldown.style.setProperty('--cooldown-sweep', `${Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - remaining / duration)) * 360}deg`);
